[Wang Shi Long]
Hm? Aren't you a customer? I am Wang Shi Long, the chef of this restaurant.

[王世龍]
嗯？你是顧客嗎？我是王世龍，這家餐廳的廚師。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
My family has served food to Lord Bai Long for a long time. This restaurant is own by my family and I am the successor.
scripts.translation:
[王世龍]
我家世代為白龍大人提供美食。這家餐廳由我家經營，我是繼承人。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
Every dish my family cooks is counted among the most delicious food in Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[王世龍]
我家烹製的每一道菜，都被譽為洛陽最美味的美食。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
Our Dragon Soup won especially high praise from our Lord Bai Long.
scripts.translation:
[王世龍]
我們的龍湯尤其受到了白龍大人的高度讚揚。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
I'm also proud to tell you that my family only uses the freshest, highest quality ingredients for our dishes.
scripts.translation:
[王世龍]
我也很自豪地告訴您，我家只使用最新鮮、最高品質的食材來烹飪菜餚。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
We have been popular in Luoyang for hundreds and hundreds of years because of the quality of our gourmet food.
scripts.translation:
[王世龍]
憑藉美食的高品質，我們在洛陽已經紅火了數百年。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
Recently, though, I've had a bad feeling that someone is trying to take over our restaurant...
scripts.translation:
[王世龍]
不過最近，我總覺得有人在試圖接管我們的餐廳...

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
Oh, well. Maybe I'm in a different mood because of some other reason. It's probably nothing.
scripts.translation:

^666666*Moans and Cries*^000000

of my Dragon Soup!

[Jiu Lian Bu]
Hey~
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
嘿~
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
I don't like hanging around too many people, so I came here. Listening to this stream really puts my mind at ease.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
我不喜歡在人多的地方待太久，所以來這裡了。聽著這流水聲，心裡真的很平靜。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
No offense, but I'm upset
at the sheer number of tourists coming over to Luoyang. Sure, I can understand that our town is attractive and has beautiful sights.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
別誤會，我只是對湧向洛陽的遊客數量感到不滿。雖然我能理解我們的城鎮很有吸引力，風景也很美。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
But I just can't stand crowds of people. People gather like sheep
to any place that they hear is popular, and that really bugs me!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
但我就是受不了人群。只要聽說哪裡熱鬧，人們就像羊群一樣湧過去，這真的讓我很煩躁！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Speaking of which, there's even
a place in Luoyang that's just like that. Man, I hate that restaurant!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
說到這個，洛陽甚至就有這麼個地方。天哪，我討厭那家餐廳！

scripts.text: What restaurant?
scripts.translation: 哪家餐廳？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
West of Luoyang, there's
a restaurant built on a pond. It's been around for a long time, selling food for ridiculous prices!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
洛陽西邊，有一家建在池塘上的餐廳。它開了很久了，賣的東西價格高得離譜！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Oh sure, the food and flavors
there have a long history, but I don't think that justifies how they charge their patrons!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
沒錯，那裡的食物和口味歷史悠久，但我認為這不能成為他們漫天要價的理由！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
As a young man
who loves his town,
I can't let them manipulate my people like that!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
作為一個熱愛自己城鎮的年輕男子，我不能讓他們這樣擺佈我的同胞！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
But everyone here already knows who I am, so I can't do anything! I've already had one too many, shall we say, 'incidents' with the people living here already.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
但這裡的人都認識我，所以我什麼都做不了！我已經和這裡的人發生過一些...“不愉快”的事件了。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
I've been caught for tagging walls, shoplifting, scamming, stealing a few girlfriends... So yeah, I'm not exactly known as a sterling citizen.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
我因為塗鴉牆壁、偷竊、詐騙、甚至搶過別人的女朋友被抓過...所以，我並不是什麼模範市民。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Say, wait a minute. The local people around here aren't too familiar with you. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
等等，這裡的當地人似乎並不太熟悉你。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Would you sneak into that restaurant and steal the
^3131FFDragon Soup Broth^000000 for me?
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
你能潛入那家餐廳，幫我偷出^3131FF龍湯底^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
The Dragon Soup Broth is the backbone for the restaurant
owner's secret recipe.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
龍湯底是這家餐廳老闆秘密食譜的核心。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
But they've been cheating their customers by watering that broth down and selling it for a ridiculous price! Serves them right if their secrets were stolen!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
但他們一直在摻水，然後以離譜的價格賣給顧客！如果他們的秘密被偷走了，那是他們活該！

scripts.text:

scripts.text: I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 我去！

scripts.text: No, stealing is wrong.

scripts.text:

I knew you'd
see things my way!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]

我就知道
你會站在我這邊的！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Okay, the restaurant is at the West side of Luoyang. But you gotta be careful. The workers there watch over that broth like freakin' hawks!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
好的，餐廳在洛陽西邊。但你得小心，那裡的工人盯著那鍋湯底，像鷹一樣敏銳！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
When you finally steal the broth, make sure you bring it without spilling any. Okay? Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
等你偷到湯底後，一定要保證不灑出來帶回來。好嗎？祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]

You may have
a point there.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]

你倒是有幾分道理。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
But then, that restaurant has been doing that to their customers for years! So, technically, we'd just be stealing back.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
不過話說回來，那家餐廳多年來一直在坑他們的顧客！所以從技術上講，我們這算是偷回屬於我們的東西。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
That joint isn't even that great. I mean, it's so obvious that they rip off their customers! Dragon Soup?! More like... Dragon Crap Soup!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
那家店其實也就那樣。我是說，他們坑顧客簡直太明顯了！龍湯？！還不如叫...龍屎湯！

scripts.text:

哇，我還以為你正趕去餐廳呢。你最好快點動身了。

洛陽最美的地方，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Whenever I'm depressed
or need to relax, I just sit here in enjoy the breeze. It helps me forget all my worries.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
每當我心情低落或需要放鬆時，我就坐在這裡享受微風。這能幫我忘掉所有的煩惱。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Heh heh, the best part is, this place is far away from my older sister. Man, that woman can nag, nag, nag, all day long.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
嘿嘿，最棒的是，這裡離我姐姐很遠。天哪，那個女人整天嘮叨個不停。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Why don't you sit down and close your eyes, and feel that soothing wind. It's pretty refreshing...
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
坐下來，閉上眼睛，感受一下這舒緩的微風。感覺挺清爽的...

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Also...
I'm a little
embarrassed to
say this but...
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
還有...
我有點
不好意思
說這個，但是...

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
I'm the kind of guy who speaks his mind. If there's something you just wanna say, but can't, it's kind of like poison in your mind.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
我是個有話直說的人。如果你心裡有什麼話想說卻說不出口，那就像心裡藏著毒一樣。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
You know what I'm talking about, right? If you bottle something up inside of you, it just causes you anxiety you don't need.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
你懂我的意思吧？把情緒憋在心裡，只會讓你產生不必要的焦慮。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
So...
This is what you do.
Clench your fist, take
a deep breath.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
所以...
你要這樣做。
握緊拳頭，
深吸一口氣。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
And just yell
whatever you want!
If you don't know
the words, just
screaming will do.
Let everything out!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
然後想喊什麼就喊什麼！
如果不知道說什麼，
直接尖叫也沒關係。
把一切都發洩出來！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Ready~!
Say it out loud!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
準備好了嗎~！
大聲喊出來！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
So, how do you feel?
Don't you feel better now? Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
那麼，感覺怎麼樣？
現在是不是感覺好多了？哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
So from now on, whenever you
wanna relieve yourself of stress, come see me and we'll come back to this place. Call it my way of saying thanks.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
所以，以後每當你想釋放壓力，就來找我，我們會回到這個地方。就當是我表達感謝的方式吧。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
So...
Whaddya wanna do?
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
那麼...
你想做什麼？

scripts.text: Shout.
scripts.translation: 大喊

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Alright~!
Say it out loud!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
好~！
大聲喊出來！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
So, how do you feel? Don't you feel better now?
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
那麼，感覺怎麼樣？現在是不是感覺好多了？

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Ahhh...
Alright, let's
get a groove on.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
啊哈...
好了，讓我們
進入狀態吧。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Hey, pal~! This is my turf! Whaddya think you're doin' here?!
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
嘿，夥計~！這是我的地盤！你以為你在幹什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Now...
Get the hell
outta here.
scripts.translation:
[九連步]
現在...
趕緊滾
出這裡。

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
I used to be
an enthusiastic
martial artist.
scripts.translation:
[金偉靈]
我曾經是一名
充滿熱情的
武術家。

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
Although I became an
assistant chef for a living, I always think of myself as a martial artist first.
scripts.translation:
[金偉靈]
雖然我為了生計成為了廚師助手，但我始終認為自己是武術家。

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
So, I decided to reflect the spirit of the martial arts into my cooking. We are often very busy when there are many customers.
scripts.translation:
[金偉靈]
所以，我決定將武術的精神融入烹飪中。當顧客很多時，我們通常非常忙碌。

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
When we're busy, I can use my martial arts to cook cuisine much more quickly! Hahaha~ Martial arts can be very practical!
scripts.translation:
[金偉靈]
當我們忙碌時，我可以用武術更快地烹飪菜餚！哈哈~武術非常實用！

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
Waaa-!!!!
scripts.translation:
[金偉靈]
哇啊——！！

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
Waaa Taaah-!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[金偉靈]
哇啊——塔啊——！！！！

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
Waaa...
Waaa Taaah-!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[金偉靈]
哇啊...
哇啊——塔啊——！！！！

[Jin Wei Ling]
Hahahaha! Look these perfect vergetable slices! Muhahahaha!!
I will continue to hone my martial arts through cooking!
scripts.translation:
[金偉靈]
哈哈哈！看這些完美的蔬菜切片！穆哈哈哈哈哈！！
我會繼續通過烹飪磨練我的武術！

^666666*Sigh*^000000 I am so disappointed. I came all the way down here to taste the food! I can't believe they don't sell it anymore!

[李敏]
^666666*嘆氣*^000000 我太失望了。我大老遠跑下來就是為了嚐嚐這裡的菜！真不敢相信他們不再賣了！

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
The worst part is that I'm already addicted to the taste! ^666666*Sob...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
最糟糕的是，我已經對那個味道上癮了！^666666*嗚咽...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
Well, I don't really
live here in Luoyang.
Still, I come here often
enough to visit.
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
其實，我不住在洛陽。
不過，我還是經常來這裡逛逛。

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
I just returned
because I've got
a huge craving for the
food I tasted here
a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
我剛剛回來，
因為我很想念
之前在這裡嚐到的
那道菜。

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
For some reason, I can't forget it. I can't get it out of my mind!
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
不知為何，我忘不了它。它一直在我腦海裡揮之不去！

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
The taste, the texture.
The sweetness, melting down into my mouth, and its tempting scent lingering on my lips...
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
那味道，那口感。
甜味在口中融化，誘人的香氣縈繞在唇邊...

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
Ummmmm...
Royal Jelly!
It makes my
mouth water~
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
唔唔唔...
蜂膠！
讓我口水直流~

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
Do you know what was this restaurant's best dish throughout all of its history? Dragon Soup!
scripts.translation:
[劉嘉林]
你知道這家餐廳歷史上最出名的菜是什麼嗎？龍湯！

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
Its delicate taste comes from
a broth extracted from pure meat that does not contain any fat. So it's also a very popular diet food for the ladies.
scripts.translation:
[劉嘉林]
它的美味來自於用純瘦肉熬製的湯底，不含任何脂肪。所以它也是女士們非常喜歡的減肥食品。

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
I'm not sure what happened,
but people say this restaurant no longer sells Dragon Soup.
Was it because of the price...?
scripts.translation:
[劉嘉林]
我不確定發生了什麼，
但人們說這家餐廳不再賣龍湯了。
是因為價格太貴嗎...

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
Do you know what's the best dish at this restaurant? It's Dragon Soup! They've been selling it here for as long as this restaurant has been around.
scripts.translation:
[劉嘉林]
你知道這家餐廳最好的菜是什麼嗎？是龍湯！這家餐廳開業以來就一直賣它。

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
Its delicate taste comes from
a broth extracted from pure meat that does not contain any fat. So it's also a very popular diet food for the ladies.
scripts.translation:
[劉嘉林]
它的美味來自於用純瘦肉熬製的湯底，不含任何脂肪。所以它也是女士們非常喜歡的減肥食品。

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
It's tasty and really good for your health. Why don't you order a bowl? I've never known anyone to taste Dragon Soup and not love it!
scripts.translation:
[劉嘉林]
它美味又健康。何不點一碗嚐嚐？我從未見過有人嘗過龍湯卻不愛上的！

scripts.text:
[Jiang Rong]
Dragon Soup is known for its spicy, yet sweet and refreshing taste.
scripts.translation:
[姜榮]
龍湯以其辛辣、甜美且清爽的味道而聞名。

scripts.text:
[Jiang Rong]
It's made with all sorts of medicinal herbs, so it's good
for your health as well.
scripts.translation:
[姜榮]
它由各種草藥製成，所以對身體也很有益。

scripts.text:
[Jiang Rong]
Dragon Soup draws out the unnecessary heat created inside
the body and circulates the blood. So it helps optimize the body's functions and promotes longevity.
scripts.translation:
[姜榮]
龍湯能排出體內多餘的熱氣，促進血液迴圈。因此它有助於最佳化身體機能，延年益壽。

scripts.text:
[Jiang Rong]
I've eaten Dragon Soup regularly ever since I was young. Look at me, don't you think I look so healthy considering my age?
scripts.translation:
[姜榮]
我從小就一直喝龍湯。看看我，以我的年紀來說，是不是看起來很健康？

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
I don't feel good...
So... Totally out of it...
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
我不舒服...
所以...完全沒精神...

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
Oh, my aching body!
All my muscles are sore...
There's only one thing that could cure all of this agonizing... pain...
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
哦，我渾身痠痛！
我的肌肉都在疼...
只有一樣東西能治癒這種痛苦的...疼痛...

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
Hey kid~!
You don't look like a local!
Why don't you follow the road ahead and check out the big restaurant?
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
嘿，小孩~！
你看起來不像本地人！
何不沿著前面的路去看看那家大餐廳？

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
The soup that they sell there is probably the healthiest food you can ever find.
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
他們那裡賣的湯，大概是你能找到的最健康的食物了。

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
I guess you could eat
some of that soup
for your health.
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
我想你可以喝點那種湯，對身體好。

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
You seem to need
that soup to ease
the fatigue of your
body and mind.
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
你似乎需要那種湯，來緩解身體和精神的疲勞。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Chi Ling]
There's a strange rumor going around that the restaurant is no longer selling Dragon Soup...
scripts.translation:
[九尺靈]
最近有個奇怪的傳聞，說那家餐廳不再賣龍湯了...

scripts.text:
[Jiu Chi Ling]
Do you think
my brother did
something bad again!?
I hope not! If he did...
What am I supposed to do?!
scripts.translation:
[九尺靈]
你覺得我哥哥又做了什麼壞事嗎！？
我希望沒有！如果他真的做了...
我該怎麼辦？！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Chi Ling]
I'm worried about my brother.
He's young, rebellious and doesn't listen to anybody...
scripts.translation:
[九尺靈]
我很擔心我哥哥。
他年輕、叛逆，而且不聽任何人的話...

scripts.text:
[Jiu Chi Ling]
He just left the
house while he was
complaining about
that restaurant...
scripts.translation:
[九尺靈]
他剛才還在抱怨那家餐廳，
然後就離家出走了...

scripts.text:
[Jiu Chi Ling]
^666666*Sigh~~*^000000
I'm not gonna let him
get away this time!
scripts.translation:
[九尺靈]
^666666*嘆氣~~*^000000
這次我絕對不讓他得逞！

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
There are many pressure points on the human body. Ever since ancient times, it has been believed that each pressure point was limited
to its role and functions.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
人體有很多穴位。自古以來，人們一直認為每個穴位都有其特定的作用和功能。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
However, as I studied and experimented with every pressure point, I came to the conclusion that the use of pressure points, depending on the circumstances,
can produce different results.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
然而，在我研究和實驗了每一個穴位後，我得出了結論：根據情況的不同，穴位的使用會產生不同的效果。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Few pressure points tend to show the same symptoms, regardless of the problem. Most of the time, the effects of pressure points will differ depending on the body's health or the time of day.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
很少有穴位無論問題如何都表現出相同的症狀。大多數時候，穴位的效果會根據身體的健康狀況或一天中的時間而有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
For instance, the pressure point located on the upper side of navel is the most vulnerable point.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
例如，位於肚臍上方的穴位是最脆弱的部位。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
If pressed the wrong way, it can cause death. But between 5:15 am and 7:15 am, it's just a weak point.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
如果按壓方式不當，可能會導致死亡。但在早上5:15到7:15之間，它只是一個弱點。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Being strong as a person is not defined as mere physical strength.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
一個人的強壯，並不僅僅定義為單純的體力。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Factors such as intelligence, experience and knowledge are
also considered when judging one's strength.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
在判斷一個人的強弱時，智力、經驗和知識等因素也會被考慮在內。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Let's say you're very strong and given the most powerful weapon.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
假設你非常強壯，並且擁有最強大的武器。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
If you don't know how to use the weapon's power, you will not be strong... You will be weak.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
如果你不知道如何發揮武器的威力，你就不會強大... 你只會變得弱小。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
When the tools or weapons
overwhelm your capabilities,
the worst situations result.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
當工具或武器超出了你的能力範圍時，往往會導致最糟糕的結果。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Hmmm...
I'm in trouble...
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
嗯...
我遇到麻煩了...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I cannot do anything without my medicine. But one my patients
needs immediate treatment and
I can't leave the office...
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
沒有藥我就什麼都做不了。但我的一位病人需要立即治療，而我不能離開診所...

scripts.text: I can help you.
scripts.translation: 我可以幫你。

scripts.text: What a shame!
scripts.translation: 真遺憾！

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Huh...?
Are...
Are you serious?
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
咦...？
你...
你是認真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
This won't take much effort, but it may be too much to ask this of you, especially since we have just met.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
這不需要費什麼力氣，但要求你這樣做可能有點過分了，畢竟我們才剛剛認識。

scripts.text: If you feel burdened...
scripts.translation: 如果你覺得為難...

scripts.text: I don't mind, I'd be glad to help.
scripts.translation: 我不介意，我很樂意幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Thank you so
much for saying that.
I feel very uncomfortable asking a favor of someone I have only just met.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
非常感謝你這麼說。
向一個剛認識的人提出請求，讓我感到很不好意思。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
However, I will ask you
if we meet another time.
Now, if you'll excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
不過，如果我們下次再見面，我會向你提出請求的。
現在，請原諒我...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Hmm, I see.
Well then, let me
ask a favor of you.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
嗯，我明白了。
那麼，請讓我向你提出一個請求。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
As you heard earlier, I need
a special medicine to treat this patient. However, I'm running out of the medicine I need.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
正如你剛才聽到的，我需要一種特殊的藥來治療這位病人。然而，我需要的藥快用完了。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I will need you to get it for me since I cannot leave the patients that are waiting for me right now.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
既然我現在不能離開正在等待我的病人，就需要你去幫我取藥。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
^666666*Sigh*^000000
Misfortunes always seem
to occur one after another, don't they? My staff is currently too busy doing other errands.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
^666666*嘆氣*^000000
不幸的事情似乎總是接二連三地發生，不是嗎？我的職員目前正忙著處理其他雜事。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Please visit the
Tool Shop in town and bring me
the medicine that I need. Master will understand if you tell him you've been sent by me.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
請去鎮上的工具店，幫我取來我需要的藥。如果你告訴店主你是我派來的，他會明白的。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I am sorry for causing you
so much trouble, but if you'll excuse me, I have other patients waiting. Please hurry back with
the medicine!
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
很抱歉給你添了這麼多麻煩，但請原諒我，還有其他病人在等著。請快點帶著藥回來！

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
^666666*Sigh*^000000 For some reason, I never seem to have enough medicine in stock. Is there no one I can ask to help me?
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
^666666*嘆氣*^000000 不知為何，我的藥庫存總是不夠。難道就沒有人能幫我一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
You haven't gotten
the medicine yet...?
I hope you can get it
as soon as you can...
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
藥還沒取回來嗎...？
希望你能儘快取回來...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
In order to prescribe medicine
and apply acupuncture suited to
a patient, I must first consider many different factors related to health.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
為了開出適合病人的藥方並進行針灸治療，我必須首先考慮許多與健康相關的因素。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I must be especially careful if the patient is in critical condition or is exhibiting unusual symptoms.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
如果病人情況危急或出現異常症狀，我必須格外小心。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Umm.....
Is that so...?
I can understand if you
take your time to bring the item. There's no need to rush.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
嗯.....
是嗎...？
如果你需要時間慢慢去取，我也可以理解。不用著急。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Everybody has their own
worries, and I understand if your own problems must take priority.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
每個人都有自己的煩惱，我理解你可能需要優先處理自己的事情。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Still, it's good
to put yourself in someone
else's shoes sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
不過，偶爾站在別人的角度想一想也是好的。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Umm.....
Is that so...?
I can understand if you
take your time in bringing what I need. There's no rush.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
嗯.....
是嗎...？
如果你需要時間慢慢把東西帶回來，我也可以理解。不用著急。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Still, it's good
to put yourself in someone
else's shoes sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
不過，偶爾站在別人的角度想一想也是好的。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Ah...
You've finally
brought it to me!
Thank you so much,
I feel much more relieved...
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
啊...
你終於把它帶回來了！
非常感謝，
我感覺輕鬆多了...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I apologize
in advance,
but may I ask
another favor of you?
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
先提前致歉，
但我能否再請你幫個忙？

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I am asking you once more
as now I see that you are trustworthy. Of course, I will compensate you for your trouble.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
我再次向你提出請求，是因為現在我看你值得信賴。當然，我會補償你帶來的麻煩。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I can't help you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我無法幫你。

scripts.text: No problem.
scripts.translation: 沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Alright....
I understand.
But let me thank you
for helping me out.
Please take this...
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
好吧....
我明白了。
但還是要謝謝你幫了我的忙。
請收下這個...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
This medicine is not that
great, but it's an old family secret. I hope it will be useful to you if you find yourself in great danger.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
這個藥雖然不算特別厲害，但卻是家傳秘方。我希望如果你身處險境時，它能對你有用。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Well then,
I will see
you around.
Once again, thank
you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
那麼，
我們改天再見。
再次感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Thank you,
thank you so much!
I just ran out of some other medicines again, and I hope that you can assist me once more.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
謝謝你，
太感謝了！
我又缺了一些其他的藥，希望你能再幫我一次。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I hope that I am not causing
you too much trouble. Um, so the medicines I'll need are...
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
希望我沒有給你添太多麻煩。嗯，所以我需要的藥是...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
^0000ff2 Leopard Claw^000000 which strengthen bones, ^0000ff10 Solid Peach^000000 which strengthens muscle, ^0000ff5 Poisonous Toad Skin^000000 which replenishes the skin...

[Hua Tuo]
^0000ff20 Brown Root^000000 which regulates the heart, ^0000ff10 Sprout^000000 which eases the abdomen and ^0000ff5 Honey Pot^000000 which provides nutrition.

[Hua Tuo]
I hope you were
able to memorize all
of that. Once again, that's...
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
希望你能記住所有這些。再說一遍，那是...

當工具或武器超出了你的能力範圍時，往往會導致最糟糕的結果。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Ah...
Did you just say you're going to gather all the items soon? Oh, thank you for your kindness.
I appreciate your effort
on my behalf.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
啊...
你剛才說會盡快收集齊所有材料嗎？
非常感謝你的好意。
我很感激你為我做的這些。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Ah....
Did you just say you're going to gather all the items soon? Oh, thank you for your kindness.
I appreciate your effort
on my behalf.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
啊....
你剛才說會盡快收集齊所有材料嗎？
非常感謝你的好意。
我很感激你為我做的這些。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Umm.....
Is that so...?
I understand even
if you can't bring
the medicine right away.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
嗯.....
是嗎...？
如果你不能馬上帶來藥材，
我也能理解的。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
It's okay for now,
so don't rush yourself.
Everybody has their own problems, so I can understand if your own troubles must take priority.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
現在這樣也沒關係，
不用太著急。
每個人都有各自的煩惱，
所以我理解你需要優先處理自己的事情。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Still, it's good to see that you're understanding of the troubles other people are having.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
不過，很高興看到你能體諒他人的難處。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Ah, finally...
You've brought what I need. Thank you so much, it's such a relief to have this medicine onhand again.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
啊，終於...
你帶來了我所需要的東西。
非常感謝，
再次擁有這些藥材讓我鬆了一口氣。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I apologize in advance,
but may I ask you another favor?
I am asking for your help once more, since I know I can depend on you. Of course, I will compensate you for your trouble.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
先提前致歉，
能再麻煩你一件事嗎？
因為我知道可以信賴你，所以再次向你求助。
當然，我會補償你的辛苦。

scripts.text: I'm sorry...
scripts.translation: 抱歉...

scripts.text: No problem.
scripts.translation: 沒關係。

scripts.text:

Alright....
I understand.
But thank you for
helping me out.
Please take this...
scripts.translation:

好的....
我理解。
但還是要謝謝你幫了我。
請收下這個...

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

那麼，下次再見。
再次感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Thank you, thank you so much!
I've just run out of other medicines that my patients will be needing. I don't need too much, but you would be doing me a great favor.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
謝謝，非常感謝！
我的病人需要的其他藥材剛好用完了。
不需要太多，但如果你能幫我這個忙，我將感激不盡。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
The medicines I need are ^0000ff2 Leopard Claw^000000 which supports the bones, ^0000ff10 Solid Peach^000000 which strengthens the muscle, ^0000ff5 Poisonous Toad Skin^000000 which replenishes the skin...
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
我需要的藥材是^0000ff2花豹指甲^000000，用於強健骨骼；^0000ff10石榴桃^000000，用於增強肌肉；^0000ff5牛蛙之皮^000000，用於滋養皮膚...

scripts.text:

^0000ff20 Brown Root^000000 which regulates the heart, ^0000ff10 Sprout^000000 which eases the abdomen and ^0000ff5 Honey Pot^000000 which provides nutrition.

^3355FF10 Solid Peach^000000,
^3355FF5 Poisonous Toad Skin^000000,
^3355FF20 Brown Root^000000,
^3355FF10 Sprout^000000 and
^3355FF5 Honey Pot^000000.

[Hua Tuo]
Hm? Ah, you have returned.
Sorry, I was taking care of my other patients. Have you already gathered the medicines I'll need?
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
嗯？啊，你回來了。
抱歉，我剛才在照顧其他病人。
你已經收集好我需要的藥材了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Let's see...
Oh, you've brought them all.
Thank you so much for your
generous help. It's such a relief to have these medicines available again...
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
讓我看看...
哦，你都帶來了。
非常感謝你的慷慨相助。
再次擁有這些藥材讓我鬆了一口氣...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Please take this as a token of my appreciation. It's not much, but this medicine is an old family secret. I hope it will be helpful to you in dangerous situations.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
請收下這個作為我的一點心意。
雖然不多，但這藥方是家傳秘方。
希望它在危急時刻能對你有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
However, please remember not to take more than the recommended dosage for the pills I have given you. Even medicine, in the wrong doses, can become poison to the body.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
不過，請記住不要超過我給你的藥丸的建議劑量。
即使是藥物，如果劑量不當，也會變成身體的毒藥。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Hmm...
Unfortunately, you haven't collected everything that I need yet. Once again, please gather...
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
嗯...
很遺憾，你還沒有收集齊我需要的所有東西。
請再次收集...

[Hua Tuo]
Your health is affected by
many factors. Nutricious food and medicine alone cannot guarantee
a healthy lifestyle.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
你的健康受許多因素影響。
僅靠營養豐富的食物和藥物，並不能保證健康的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Seemingly little things like your everyday mood and behavior, your thoughts and words also contribute to states of illness or well-being.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
日常的情緒和行為，以及你的想法和言語，看似微不足道，卻也會影響身體的健康或疾病狀態。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Everyone needs time to quiet
their thoughts and relax. If you can maintain a calm mood throughout your daily life, your body will greatly benefit.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
每個人都需要時間讓思緒平靜下來，放鬆身心。如果你能在日常生活中保持心情平和，你的身體將受益匪淺。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Hahaha...
I hope you enjoy
your visit here
in Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[華佗]
哈哈...
希望你在洛陽的訪問愉快。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Zzzzzzz
Zzzzz.....
Zzzzz.....

[Wang Chuiyi]
My business hasn't been doing
well recently. And what is wrong with this weather? I don't know what's going on with the world...
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
最近生意不太好。這天氣到底怎麼了？我不知道這個世界發生了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
Darn it!
I hate this
weather...!
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
該死！
我討厭這天氣...！

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
Um? Can I help
you with anything?
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
嗯？有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: I'm here to get something for the doctor...
scripts.translation: 我來給醫生買些東西...

scripts.text: I agree, the weather really is bad.
scripts.translation: 是啊，天氣真的很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
Huh?
An errand for the doctor?
She must have run out of
medicine again. Go ahead
and check the storage.
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
什麼？
給醫生跑腿？
她肯定是又沒藥了。去倉庫看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
You can find the storage on
the opposite side of this building. There, you'll see a guy named Jiang Xiayou. Go ahead and ask him for the stuff you need.
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
倉庫在這棟建築的對面。在那裡，你會看到一個叫江夏遊的傢伙。去跟他要你需要的那些東西吧。

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
Tell me about it. This weather keeps stressing me out. Damn,
I don't think I'll live very long if I keep getting aggravated like
this by the weather...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
In the past, I was one of the
most renowned experts in the use
of poison. I even created a martial art based on its use, and formed my own martial arts organization.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
過去，我是最負盛名的毒術專家之一。
我甚至創立了一種基於毒術的武術，並建立了自己的武術組織。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Now, those memories
don't even seem real
anymore. This poem is
all I can remember...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
現在，那些記憶
甚至都不像真的了。
這首詩
是我唯一能記住的...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
As I lay in bed looking
up at the moonlight
 
It looks like the
frost on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]

仰望月光
 
它看起來像
地上的霜。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I lift head up to look
at the bright moon,
 
I lower my head
feeling homesick.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我抬起頭
看著明亮的月亮，
 
我低下頭
感到思鄉。

[Nagash Arses]
Correct. You listened to me very well. They are Assassins. Assassins that were abandoned by society.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
正確。你聽得很仔細。他們是刺客。是被社會遺棄的刺客。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
'Canine of Desert' is the name of that Assassin organization. Don't forget that.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
“沙漠之犬”就是那個刺客組織的名字。別忘了這一點。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
...
......

[Nagash Arses]
Bah! I forgot what I was just talking about! This bad memory of mine frustrates me so much!
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
哎呀！我剛才在說什麼來著！我這糟糕的記憶真讓我抓狂！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
How could you not know what the 'Canine of Desert' is?! Just how long have you been an Assassin?!
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你怎麼會不知道“沙漠之犬”是什麼呢？！你當刺客多久了？！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You're supposed to be aware of your origins and your colleagues! Oh, the shame...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你應該清楚自己的出身和同伴啊！真是丟人...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Well, I suppose I can't blame you for not knowing or remembering. When you get the chance, find someone wearing a purple suit...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
嗯，我想你不知情或忘記也不足為奇。如果有機會的話，去找找穿紫色西裝的人...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Any Assassin worth his salt should know what the 'Canine of Desert' is.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
任何合格的刺客都應該知道“沙漠之犬”是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Wait...
Let me think...
Now how did I becoming interested in the use of poison...?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
等等...
讓我想想...
我當初是怎麼對使用毒產生興趣的來著...？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I tried many things to develop my poison skills when I was young.
I tried to extract poison from Muka's needles and from purple mushrooms. Eventually, I became
an expert of toxins from my efforts.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
年輕時，我嘗試了許多方法來提升我的毒術。
我嘗試從摩卡的毒針和紫色蘑菇中提取毒素。最終，憑藉這些努力，我成為了毒素專家。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
One time I even injected
a poison into my own body
to fully test it. Yeah...
It almost killed me.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
有一次，我甚至將毒素注入自己的身體，以進行徹底的測試。沒錯...
那差點要了我的命。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I was recognized as the man who
was most highly skilled in the use of poison in the 'Canine of Desert,' and I was sent on the most crucial and dangerous missions.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我被公認為“沙漠之犬”中精通毒術的人，並被派去執行最關鍵、最危險的任務。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
One day, I was hired by the Alberta Merchant Guild to assassinate an enemy that had been threatening them. However, I never got to complete that mission.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
有一天，艾爾貝塔商人公會僱傭我去刺殺一個威脅他們的敵人。然而，我沒能完成那個任務。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
While I was on the ship to procceed with my mission, we encountered heavy wind and waves and the ship sank. I believe I was the only survivor of that accident.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
在前往執行任務的船上，我們遭遇了狂風巨浪，船沉了。我相信我是那場事故中唯一的倖存者。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I was floated helplessly on the ocean and somehow managed
to arrive here, in Luoyang. That was forty years ago.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我無助地漂浮在大海上，不知怎的竟然漂流到了這裡，洛陽。那是四十年前的事了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
It seemed that my arrival was rather timely. Luoyang was intruded by huge mobs of dangerous monsters that were even able to infiltrate the Castle of the Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我的到來似乎恰逢其時。洛陽被大量危險的魔物入侵，它們甚至滲透到了龍城堡。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Since I was one of the best Assassins of the 'Canine of Desert,' I did far more than my share of monster killing.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
既然我是“沙漠之犬”中頂尖的刺客之一，我殺死的魔物遠超我的份內之事。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
It was on the battlefield that
I met Bai Long who is now lord of this town. But back then, he was known as the 'Street Knight.'
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
正是在戰場上，我遇到了現在的城鎮領主白龍。不過那時候，他被稱為“街頭騎士”。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I remember seeing him surrounded
by enemies, and I dove into thick of battle to keep him from getting killed. We fought back to back and managed to stay alive back then.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我記得看到他被敵人包圍，我衝入戰場中心，防止他被殺死。我們背靠背作戰，在那時倖存了下來。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You have to understand that it's not easy to let someone back you
up in battle unless there's a solid trust. Those fights... were the greatest moments in my life.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你要明白，除非有堅定的信任，否則在戰鬥中讓人掩護你的後背並不容易。那些戰鬥...是我生命中最偉大的時刻。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Sadly, many of our comrades,
all of them respectable and highly skilled martial artists, fell in battle. The number of monsters we had to contend with was just overwhelming.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
遺憾的是，我們的許多同志，都是受人尊敬且技藝高超的武術家，在戰鬥中犧牲了。我們要對抗的魔物數量實在太多了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Still, I managed to continue my poison research, even during those tough times. I studied medicine in this town and was able use that knowledge to enhance my understanding of poisons.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
儘管如此，即使在那些艱難時期，我仍堅持進行毒物研究。我在這個城鎮學習醫學，並利用那些知識加深了對毒素的理解。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I created a new skill based on all of my knowledge, and learned how
to put poison on weapons.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我基於所有知識創造了一項新技能，並學會了如何在武器上塗抹毒素。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I even learned martial arts in Luoyang, and combined that
knowledge with my poison expertise to create my own unique fighting style.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我甚至在洛陽學習了武術，並將這些知識與我的毒術專長結合，創造出了自己獨特的戰鬥風格。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Well, that's my story.
But now, I just miss my
home town. I miss the heat
of the desert and the glare
of the blazing sun...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
好了，這就是我的故事。
但現在，我只是想念我的家鄉。我懷念沙漠的熱量和燃燒的太陽的刺眼光芒...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Ah, Morocc.
That name brings
back memories of
being an Assassin
in the 'Canine of Desert.'
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
啊，摩洛哥。
這個名字讓我想起了
作為“沙漠之犬”刺客的日子。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
I wish I could see
Morocc just once before I die.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
^666666*嘆息*^000000
在死之前，
我真希望能再見摩洛哥一面。

scripts.text: Tell him news of Morocc.
scripts.translation: 告訴他莫洛克的近況。

scripts.text: Ask about 'Canine of Desert.'
scripts.translation: 詢問關於“沙漠之犬”的事。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Hm...?
Is there anything
you want to say?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
嗯...？
你有什麼
想說的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have news
of Morocc...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有關於
摩洛哥的訊息...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I see...
Thank you for
telling me that.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
原來如此...
謝謝你告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I see!
You just said, {0}. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
原來如此！
你剛才說了，{0}。謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I just told you what 'Canine of Desert.' If you can't remember what I just told you, it's no use for me to explain further. You go ahead and tell me what it is.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我剛才已經告訴過你“沙漠之犬”是什麼了。如果你不記得我剛才說的話，我再解釋也沒用。你自己說說看那是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Correct. You listened to me very well. They are Assassins. Assassins that were abandoned by society.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
正確。你聽得很仔細。他們是刺客。是被社會遺棄的刺客。

scripts.text:

Canine of Desert
is the name of an
Assassin organization.
Do not forget that.
scripts.translation:

“沙漠之犬”
是一個刺客組織的名字。
別忘了這一點。

How could you not know what the 'Canine of Desert' is?! Just how long have you been an Assassin?!
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你怎麼會不知道“沙漠之犬”是什麼呢？！你當刺客多久了？！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你應該清楚自己的出身和同伴啊！真是丟人...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Well, I suppose I can't blame you for not knowing or remembering. When you get the chance, find someone wearing a purple suit...
scripts.translation:
