嗯，我想你不知情或忘記也不足為奇。如果有機會的話，去找找穿紫色西裝的人...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Any Assassin worth his salt should know what the 'Canine of Desert' is.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
任何合格的刺客都應該知道“沙漠之犬”是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Did you just say you
want to learn about the
use of poison?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你剛才說
想學習毒物的用法？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Why do you want
to learn about it?
Even if I wanted to
teach, I'm too old to
remember everything
clearly...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你為什麼想學這個？
就算我想教，
我也太老了，
記不清所有細節了...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Go find my last disciple,
^0000FFSong Zhi Du^000000, as he may tell you something useful. He's working at the doctor's office. If it weren't for him, I'd be starving now.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
去找我最後的弟子，
^0000FF宋志度^000000，他可能會告訴你一些有用的事。他在診所工作。要不是有他，我現在早就餓死了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Did you just say you
want to learn about the
use of poison?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你剛才說
想學習毒物的用法？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Why do you want
to learn about it?
Even if I wanted to
teach, I'm too old to
remember everything
clearly...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你為什麼想學這個？
就算我想教，
我也太老了，
記不清所有細節了...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You're asking me how
things came to be like
this? Life used to be good.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你問我事情是怎麼變成這樣的？
以前生活挺好的。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
As I told you, I distinguished myself in the battles with monsters. I was rewarded with Luoyang citizenship and given
gifts of money.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
正如我所說，我在與魔物的戰鬥中表現突出。我因此獲得了洛陽的公民身份，並收到了金錢賞賜。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I was invited to join a martial arts organization that specialized in the use of poison. I joined them, excited about further broadening my knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我被邀請加入一個專門研究毒物使用的武術組織。我興奮地加入了他們，希望能進一步拓寬我的知識。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I was stunned by the enormous body of knowledge about toxins that they provided. I tried to learn as much as I could so I could develop my own, unique poisoning skills.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
他們提供的關於毒素的龐大知識讓我震驚。我試圖儘可能多地學習，以便開發出我自己獨特的毒術技能。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
As I studied with them, together we started to clear the town of the remaining monsters. Can you guess the results of our efforts to clean up the city?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
在他們那裡學習期間，我們一起開始清理城鎮中剩餘的魔物。你能猜到我們清理城市的成果嗎？

scripts.text: It must have been good.
scripts.translation: 那一定很好吧。

scripts.text: I guess it was okay?
scripts.translation: 我想應該還行？

scripts.text: I don't know, but how did it go?
scripts.translation: 我不知道，但結果如何？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Did you even listen to me? It's no use talking to you if you don't even care about what I have to say.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你根本沒在聽我說話吧？如果你根本不在乎我說的話，那跟你談也沒用。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I'm sorry for keeping you from what you wanted to do. Take care of yourself, youngster.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
抱歉耽誤了你原本想做的事。保重身體，年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You're right!
We got rid of every
single monster in the city!
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你說得對！
我們把城裡所有的魔物都清理乾淨了！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Just okay...?
I don't think you realized how powerful we were back then! Eh...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
只是“還行”嗎？
我想你並沒有意識到我們當時有多強大。呃...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Sorry for keeping you from what you wanted to do. Take care of yourself, youngster.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
抱歉耽誤了你原本想做的事。保重身體，年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
We got rid of every single monster in the city!
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我們把城裡所有的魔物都清理乾淨了！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
We managed to eliminate every monster that was wandering around Luoyang. At the time, we were the only people brave enough to take on this sort of task.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我們消滅了所有在洛陽遊蕩的魔物。當時，只有我們有勇氣承擔這樣的任務。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Unfortunately, other martial arts organizations grew envious of our success, insisting that we were dishonorable for using poison to attack our enemies.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
不幸的是，其他武術組織嫉妒我們的成功，指責我們使用毒藥攻擊敵人是不光彩的行為。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Although we can accept criticism for our use of poison, we were finally blamed for something we never would have done.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
雖然我們可以接受對使用毒藥的批評，但最終我們卻被指責做了我們絕不會做的事。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Someone put poison into a meal which was eaten by a son of the lord and then falsely accused us!
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
有人在食物裡下了毒，被領主之子吃下後，他們竟然誣陷是我們乾的！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
In the end, our organization was disbanded and I was put in jail.
I suffered through much to escape from prison...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
最後，我們的組織被解散，我也被投入了監獄。
為了越獄，我受盡了折磨...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
However, because of all the injuries I've had to endure in jail and in my escape attempts,
I can no longer use my
martial arts.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
然而，由於在監獄和越獄嘗試中遭受的種種傷痛，
我已經無法再使用
武術了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Even to this day, the police are hounding after me. I really want to tell the lord of Luoyang that I'm innocent, but it may be
too late now...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
直到今天，警察仍在追捕我。我真的很想向洛陽的領主證明我的清白，但現在可能已經太晚了...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I...
I don't want
to talk about that.
Let's not talk about it.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我...
我不想談那些。
我們別談這個了。

scripts.text: Grin at him.
scripts.translation: 對他咧嘴一笑

scripts.text: Lament for his grief.
scripts.translation: 為他的悲傷感到惋惜

scripts.text: Reprove him.
scripts.translation: 責備他

scripts.text: Listen to the poem again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍那首詩

scripts.text: Show him a sad look.
scripts.translation: 露出悲傷的表情

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Yeah, I don't blame you.
I know I look stupid. Legally,
I'm a criminal after all.
I don't any friends and
there's no one I can trust.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
是啊，我不怪你。
我知道自己看起來很蠢。在法律上，
我畢竟是個罪犯。
我沒有朋友，
也沒有可以信任的人。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
How can you sympathize?
I doubt anyone has had
experiences that are
much worse than mine...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你怎能同情我？
我懷疑很少有人
經歷過比我更糟糕的
事情...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Wha--? I haven't wronged you in any way! Why must you be so mean to an old man? You don't even know half of what I've had to go through.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
什...？我並沒有得罪你！
為什麼你要對一個老人這麼刻薄？
你根本不知道我經歷過什麼。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
As I lay in bed looking
up at the moonlight
 
It looks like the
frost on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
當我躺在床上
仰望月光
 
它看起來像
地上的霜。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I lift head up to look
at the bright moon,
 
I lower my head
feeling homesick.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我抬起頭
看著明亮的月亮，
 
我低下頭
感到思鄉。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Do you miss your hometown
as much as I do? I'm envious
of you, youngster. You have
the freedom to go
wherever you want.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你和我一樣思念家鄉嗎？
年輕人，我很羨慕你。
你擁有自由，
想去哪裡就去哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I'm a wanted criminal.
Even if I were free to
travel, I may not have
the strength to try.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我是個通緝犯。
即使我有自由，
我可能也沒有
嘗試的力氣了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Let's not talk about this any longer. It's reminding me of
my worst memories.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
別再談這個了。
這讓我想起了
最痛苦的回憶。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Ah, you look just like I did when
I was young. It seems you know
a little something about poison.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
啊，你看起來
像我年輕時的樣子。
看來你對毒藥
略知一二。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
It seems you haven't
perfected your knowledge yet,
though. Oh well, I doubt I can
pinpoint what you need to master.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
不過，看來你還沒有
完全掌握相關知識。
算了，我也很難
指出你需要精通什麼。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I'm too old to remember anything. Ha ha ha. Maybe if I saw something related to poison, I might remember something...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我年紀太大了，記不起任何事。
哈哈。也許如果看到
與毒藥有關的東西，
我可能會想起些什麼...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
No, no...
I think I'm too old
to remember anything.
Anything at all.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
不，不...
我想我年紀太大了，
記不起任何事。
任何事都記不起來了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I'm too old to remember anything. Ha ha ha. Maybe if I saw something related to poison, I might remember something...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我年紀太大了，記不起任何事。
哈哈。也許如果看到
與毒藥有關的東西，
我可能會想起些什麼...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
No, no...
I think I'm too old
to remember anything.
Anything at all.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
不，不...
我想我年紀太大了，
記不起任何事。
任何事都記不起來了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
If you wish to talk about poison, you'd better go to the doctor's office. My last disciple is
working there.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
如果你想談論毒藥，
最好去診所。
我最後的弟子
在那裡工作。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Now, let me rest.
I am very tired.
I... I hope he doesn't
have any bad intentions...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
好了，讓我休息一下吧。
我很累。
我...我希望他
沒有惡意...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Aren't you the youngster
I talked to a while ago?
Did you get a chance
to meet my disciple?
How was he?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你難道不是
剛才和我說話的那個年輕人嗎？
你有機會見到我的弟子嗎？
他怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
He was sick all the time when he was young, so he worried me a lot. But now I'm proud of him and he's doing as well just any other fine young man.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
他小時候總是生病，
讓我很擔心。但現在我為他感到驕傲，
他和其他優秀的年輕人一樣
做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I am living only for him,
and hope that he becomes a great healer someday. Recently, I've found that my sole comfort is in treating diseases for other people...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我活著只是為了他，
希望他將來能成為一位偉大的醫生。
最近，我發現我唯一的慰藉
就是為別人治病...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
By the way...
You look pale...
Did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
順便問一下...
你臉色蒼白...
發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text: I want to talk about your diciple.
scripts.translation: 我想談談你的弟子。

scripts.text: I don't feel good.
scripts.translation: 我感覺不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Oh...
I see...
But take care
of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
哦...
我明白了...
但請照顧好自己。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You better enjoy your physical strength when you're young. When you're my age, it's tough to regain your health once you lose it.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
趁年輕好好享受你的體力吧。
到了我這個年紀，
一旦失去健康，就很難恢復了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Did something happen to him?
I've been worried since he hasn't come to visit me since you last came to speak with me.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
他出什麼事了嗎？
自從你上次來和我說話後，
他就沒來探望我，
我一直很擔心。

scripts.text: Give him Poison Bottle.
scripts.translation: 給他毒藥瓶

scripts.text: Cancel and go to 'Song Zhi Du.
scripts.translation: 取消並去找宋志度

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Huh!?
Isn't this...!?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
什麼！？
這不是...！？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I've dreamed of creating
a poison of such potency!
W-where did you find this?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我一直夢想著能創造出如此強力的毒藥！
你...你是在哪裡找到這個的？

scripts.text: It's common nowadays.
scripts.translation: 現在很常見

scripts.text: Explain to him what happened.
scripts.translation: 向他解釋發生了什麼

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Really...?
Then someone
finally figured it out.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
真的嗎...？
看來終於有人
研究出來了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I shared all of my knowledge with others, so I guess a doctor might have figured how to create this.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我把所有的知識都傳授給了別人，
我想大概是某位醫生
研究出了製造這種毒藥的方法吧。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Now I feel depressed
for some reason...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
^666666*嘆息...*^000000
不知道為什麼，
我現在感覺很沮喪...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Nagash Arses how
Song Zhi Du created this Deadly Poison Bottle and his plan to get his revenge on the lord of Luoyang.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF告訴納加什·阿爾塞斯，
宋志度是如何製造出這瓶致命猛毒的，
以及他向洛陽領主復仇的計劃。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000

[Nagash Arses]
Will you...
Will you excuse
me for a second...?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
請...請允許我
失禮片刻...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Nothing much.

[Nagash Arses]
Hmm...?
I guess you don't know what is going on. I've heard some bad rumors about him, which is why I'm asking.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
嗯...？
看來你並不清楚發生了什麼。
我聽到了一些關於他的壞訊息，
所以才這麼問。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I hope he'll be fine.
After all, he's truly
kind at heart.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
希望他沒事。
畢竟，他心地
真的很善良。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Hmm...?
I guess you don't know what is going on. I've heard some bad rumors about him, which is why I'm asking.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
嗯...？
看來你並不清楚發生了什麼。
我聽到了一些關於他的壞訊息，
所以才這麼問。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I hope he'll be fine.
After all, he's truly
kind at heart.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
希望他沒事。
畢竟，他心地
真的很善良。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Oh, you don't?
Well, that can happen
sometimes when you're
in a foreign land for
too long. I hope you
feel better soon.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
哦，是嗎？
有時候在異國他鄉待太久
也會發生這種事。
希望你快點好起來。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Recently...
I've been getting
a bad feeling...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
最近...
我總有一種
不好的預感...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I want to blame it
on my solitude, but...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我想把這歸咎於
我的孤獨，但是...

scripts.text: ^3355FFNagash Arses. He is no longer a well-known Assassin or the martial arts organization of which he was once master has long since disbanded.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF納加什·阿爾塞斯。他不再是那位著名的刺客，
他曾經統領的武術組織也早已解散。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow he is but a poor old man
who is in anguish over his disciple. No matter what you say, he continues to talk about something totally unrelated, as if in a dream.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF如今他只是一個為弟子痛苦不堪的可憐老人。
無論你說什麼，他都像是在夢中一樣，
不停地談論著完全不相干的事情。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Youngster...
I beg of you.
Please do not let him
bring any harm to the lord.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
年輕人...
求求你了。
請千萬不要讓他
傷害到白龍大人。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
If you cannot stop him,
then please interrupt him
from carrying out his plan.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
如果你無法阻止他，
那就請打斷他
實施計劃的行動。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I tried...
To convince myself
that what I had heard
were just ugly rumors.
I was wrong...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我曾試圖...
說服自己
聽到的那些
只是惡意的謠言。
但我錯了...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I am pretty sure he's been asking you, as well as others, for aid. Even if you do not agree to carry out his plan, I'm sure he will find someone to poison Lord Bai Long.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我很確定他也在向你，
以及其他的人求助。
即使你不同意執行他的計劃，
我相信他也會找到別人
去毒害白龍大人。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
There is only one way he can poison
the lord. He likes drinking, and has a favorite drink bottle he keeps with him all the time. You must get rid of his drink.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
他毒害大人的方法只有一種。
他喜歡喝酒，而且總是隨身攜帶
一個他最喜歡的酒壺。你必須毀掉他的酒。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Please, I beg you.
For my sake, as well
as that of my disciple,
Luoyang's leader must live...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
求求你了。
為了我，也為了我的弟子，
洛陽的首領必須活下去...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
So...
What...
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
那麼...
發生了...
什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I made it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我做到了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You did?!
Oh~ thank you,
thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
你做到了？！
噢~ 謝謝你，
真的非常感謝！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Thank God I've
lived this long.
And... I just realized
something while you away.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
感謝上天讓我
活到了現在。
而且... 趁你不在的時候，
我突然意識到了一件事。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
This is a journal that I have been writing for 15 years about my feelings of guilt, and what really happened in the past. I hope you can deliver this to the lord for me.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
這是我寫了15年的日記，
記錄了我內心的愧疚，
以及過去真正發生的事。
希望你能把它交給白龍大人。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou obtained
^0000FFPoison King
Nagash Arses' Journal^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你獲得了
^0000FF納加什·阿爾塞斯的日記^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I hope you
can deliver this
to Lord Bai Long...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
希望你能把它
交給白龍大人...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou gave him the
^0000FFLetter from Bai Long^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你給了他
^0000FF白龍大人的信件^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
What's this...?
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
這是什麼...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Why, he's invited me
to take the position of
a government official!
I'm truly grateful!
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
原來，他邀請我
擔任政府官員！
我真的非常感激！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
However, please let him
know that I must respectfully decline his offer. I'm afraid that I may be a burden to him once again.
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
不過，請讓他知道，
我必須恭敬地拒絕他的好意。
我怕自己再次成為他的負擔。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Please tell him that I wish to enjoy the rest of my life here. Also, there are people here
who still need me...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
請告訴他，我希望在這裡
度過餘生。而且，這裡還有
需要我照顧的人...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Thank you, youngster.
You've stopped my disciple
and helped me make up
with an old friend...
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
謝謝你，年輕人。
你阻止了我的弟子，
還幫我與一位老友
重歸於好...

scripts.text: ^3355FFNagash Arses put his palm on your back, and you can feel his strength flowing into you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF納加什·阿爾塞斯將手掌放在你的背上，你能感覺到他的力量流入你的身體。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou grow dizzy, but you also feel like you're becoming more powerful and gaining experience.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你感到一陣眩暈，但同時也覺得自己變得更強了，並獲得了經驗值。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThen...
Everything blacks out...^000000

^3355FFHe looks tired
for some reason,
as if he's thinking
of Morocc, his hometown.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不知為何，他看起來很疲憊，
彷彿正在思念他的故鄉莫洛克。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou reflect on when he gave you his remaining strength and remember that he told you that he used to be one of the greatest Assassins...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你回想起他將剩餘的力量傳授給你的那一刻，
記得他曾告訴你，他曾是偉大的刺客之一...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFBut after all that's happened,
he just looks like an old man who likes treating other people. It seems that he's finally at peace with himself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF但經歷了一切之後，
他看起來只是一個喜歡照顧他人的老人。似乎他終於與自己和解了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
My name, Nagash Arses,
is also the name of the poison king in the legend of Arcturus. I have good reason to be proud of my name!
scripts.translation:
[納加什·阿爾塞斯]
我的名字，納加什·阿爾塞斯，
也是阿爾克圖斯傳說中“毒王”的名字。我有充分的理由為這個名字感到自豪！

scripts.text:
^3355FF * Wait a minute! *
You're carrying too many items with you right now. Please put some of your things into Kafra Storage and try again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF * 等等！ *
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。請將一些物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再試一次。^000000

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Let's see, there's that medicine, and then the medicine over here...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
讓我看看，這裡有那種藥，還有那邊的藥...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
...
......

[Song Zhi Du]
I feel like you're looking at me. Is there something that you want?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我感覺你在看著我。有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Ask him about his master.
scripts.translation: 詢問他的師父

scripts.text: Ask about Poison Organization.
scripts.translation: 詢問毒組織

scripts.text: Ask why he's working here.
scripts.translation: 詢問他為何在此工作

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I guess there's nothing you really need from me. Well then, if you'll excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
看來你並沒有特別需要我的地方。那麼，失陪了...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm kind of busy right now. You see, we're running out of medicine...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哦，抱歉，我現在有點忙。你看，我們的藥快用完了...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
My master, Hua Tuo,
is also having difficulty treating all of his patients. I must get him the medicine that he needs...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我的師父華佗，
也很難應付所有的病人。我必須去給他取需要的藥...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
What...?
What did
you just say...?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
什麼...？
你剛才說什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
{0}...?

[Song Zhi Du]
I've never heard of that organization in my life. I'm sorry I can't help you. Now, if you'll excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我從未聽說過那個組織。抱歉幫不了你。那麼，失陪了...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Of course I'm working here to learn about medicine. I'm grateful for the chance to work under the most famous doctor in this area.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我當然是在這裡學習醫術。我很感激能有機會在這位當地最著名的醫生手下工作。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Doctor Hua Tuo is such a great person. I'm more than happy to assist him in saving the lives of others with his medical knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
華佗醫生真是位了不起的人。能協助他用醫術拯救他人的生命，我感到非常榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Even though I'm just in charge of the medicine storage, I'm working hard to become his disciple someday.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
雖然我目前只負責管理藥材倉庫，但我一直在努力，希望能有朝一日成為他的弟子。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
And working with Doctor Hua Tuo is really worthwhile. Well, sometimes it's really hard to supply medicine when we have too many patients though.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
和華佗醫生一起工作真的很有價值。不過，有時候病人太多，供應藥材確實很吃力。

scripts.text: Why don't you gather medicinal herbs then?
scripts.translation: 那你去採集草藥吧？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
My job is keeping this storage.
I'm not supposed to leave my position. I need to organize the herbs, and make sure they're in good condition.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我的工作是看守這個倉庫。
我不應該擅離職守。我需要整理草藥，並確保它們狀態良好。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Well, well. Thank you for your trouble. I didn't expect you to gather all these herbs for us...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哎呀，真是麻煩你了。沒想到你會為我們採集這麼多草藥...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I suppose I underestimated you. By the way, do you know anything about poison?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
看來是我小看你了。順便問一下，你瞭解毒藥嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I am kind of interested in it.
scripts.translation: 是的，我對此頗感興趣。

scripts.text: No, not at all.
scripts.translation: 不，完全不瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Oh, I see. Well, if you have some time, why don't you go visit my old master in the slums?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哦，我明白了。如果你有空的話，不妨去貧民窟拜訪一下我的舊日師父？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
If you two get along, I will tell you something important.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
如果你們相處融洽，我會告訴你一些重要的事情。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Huh. I see. Well, thank you for your trouble once again. I hope you have a good time in Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
嗯，我明白了。再次感謝你的辛苦付出。祝你在洛陽玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
...
So, did you talk
to my old master?
It seems he really
likes you.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
...
那麼，你和我的舊日師父談過了嗎？
看來他真的很喜歡你。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
As you know, my master has been accused of something he didn't do! And they crippled his use of the martial arts!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你也知道，我的師父被誣陷做了他沒做過的事！而且他們廢掉了他的武功！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I can't forgive what
they've have done to my master!
I want to grind their bones
to powder! And that's before
I kill them!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我無法原諒他們對我師父所做的一切！
我要把他們的骨頭磨成粉！
在那之前，我要先殺了他們！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
He's innocent and all he did
was research poison with all
of his effort! And for that,
they destroyed him!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
他是無辜的，他只是一心一意地研究毒藥！
就因為這個，他們毀了他！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I was young
when it happened...
Too young to know
any martial arts.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
事情發生的時候我還很小...
太小了，還不懂什麼武功。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I couldn't protect him.
All I could do was hide and
watch other people get killed.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我沒能保護他。
我只能躲藏起來，看著其他人被殺害。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I hate myself
for not being strong!
But, my body isn't suited
for martial arts.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我恨自己不夠強大！
但我的身體並不適合習武。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
All I can do is maintain my weak body and make sure it's reasonably healthy. Even so, if it weren't for my master, I'd be dead
in the streets...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我能做的只是維持我虛弱的身體，確保它還算健康。即便如此，如果不是我的師父，我早就死在街頭了...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
It was my master who picked me up from the streets and cured me. So, I've decided to become a doctor and save as many lives as I can.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
是師父把我從街頭撿回來，治好了我的病。所以，我決定成為一名醫生，拯救儘可能多的生命。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
But before
I do that,
I want ^FF0000revenge^000000!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
但在那之前，
我要^FF0000復仇^000000！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
As I told you, I am weak.
Too weak... I know that from
the bottom of my heart.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
正如我告訴你的，我很虛弱。
太虛弱了...我從心底裡知道這一點。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
But...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
但是...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I am knowledgable about medicine, especially the use of poison. I can tell you that I'm one of the best.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我對醫學很有研究，尤其是毒藥的使用。我可以告訴你，我是最擅長的人之一。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Poison can kill people but it can also be used to save lifes. The people who destroyed my master
will pay the price.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
毒藥可以殺人，也可以救人。那些毀了我師父的人，必將付出代價。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Do you understand
why I'm furious!?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你明白我為什麼
如此憤怒嗎！?

scripts.text: But revenge isn't good.
scripts.translation: 復仇是不對的。

scripts.text: Yes, I fully understand.
scripts.translation: 是的，我完全理解。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hmm...
I see.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
嗯...
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I suppose you couldn't
understand the way I feel.
After all, you didn't have
to go through the same
things I did.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我想你無法理解我的感受。
畢竟，你沒有經歷過
和我一樣的事情。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I suppose I expected too much, since my master likes you. How could you know the rage and
sadness that I feel!?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我想是我期望太高了，畢竟師父喜歡你。你怎麼可能知道我所感受到的
憤怒和悲傷！?

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Fine.
Go do whatever
you were going to do.
I'm just disappointed...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
算了。
去做你該做的事吧。
我只是很失望...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Yes! Yes!
You do understand!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
是的！是的！
你確實理解！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I volunteered for this medicine storage position so that I can secretly study poison! Now, the time for action has come!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我自願申請這個藥品倉庫的職位，就是為了能偷偷研究毒藥！現在，行動的時刻到了！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Still, I'll need some materials to complete my research. Then, when
I succeed and create a poison pill, I'll need someone to carry my revenge out for me.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
不過，我還需要一些材料來完成我的研究。然後，當我成功製出毒藥丸，我需要有人替我執行復仇。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Since my body is so frail, I can't bear the tension and rage of seeing my lifelong enemy face to face.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
由於我身體虛弱，我無法承受與畢生仇敵面對面時的緊張和憤怒。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I'm so disappointed.
You've even seen the
pitiable state of my
master for yourself!
How could you not
understand me?!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我太失望了。
你甚至親眼見過
我師父那可憐的樣子！
你怎麼可能不理解我？!

scripts.text: I'm sorry for last time.
scripts.translation: 上次的事我很抱歉。

scripts.text: No matter what, revenge isn't good.
scripts.translation: 無論如何，復仇是不對的。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
If you really
feel sorry for me,
then you must help me
carry out my revenge!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
如果你真的
為我感到難過，
那就必須幫我
實現復仇！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I still need to complete the
poison potion I'm creating. I hope you can bring what I need to finish it. Go and get me...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我還需要完成
我正在研製的毒藥。
希望你能幫我
找來所需的材料。去給我弄點...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
^0000FF4 Bee Sting,
10 Venom Canine,
10 Empty Potion,
30 Green Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
^0000FF4 10 只蜜蜂，
10 只毒犬，
10 個空瓶子，
30 瓶綠色藥水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
An apology is fine, but you must also show me that you are sorry and help me carry out my plan. Do you have any problem with this?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
道歉是可以的，
但你必須向我證明
你的誠意，並幫我
實現計劃。你有意見嗎？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Oh, forget about it.
I don't think I can ever
make you understand how I feel.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
算了，隨你吧。
我覺得我永遠
無法讓你理解
我的感受。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
So, did you
gather everything
I asked of you?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
那麼，你
都把我需要的
東西集齊了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: What do you need again?
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah...
With these, I accept your apology. Thank you for all the trouble you went through to get this stuff.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊...
有了這些，我接受你的道歉。
謝謝你費心去
收集這些東西。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Now that you're this involved, you're in this with me all the way! I've been waiting for this
day for years...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
既然你已經
捲入其中，那就
跟我一起到底吧！
我等待這一天
已經好多年了...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
All that's left is to create this poison, and then to get the
lord of Luoyang to drink it...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
剩下的就是
製造這種毒藥，
然後讓洛陽的
領主喝下去...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Where are things
I asked you to bring?
Are you testing my
patience or what?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我讓你帶的
東西在哪裡？
你是在考驗
我的耐心嗎？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
You're still missing some of the items I need. I must have them all in order to finish making this poison!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你還缺一些
我需要的材料。
我必須集齊所有
材料才能完成毒藥！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
*Sigh...*
Go and get me...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
*嘆氣...*
去給我弄點...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
^0000FF4 Bee Sting,
10 Venom Canine,
10 Empty Potion,
30 Green Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
^0000FF4 10 只蜜蜂，
10 只毒犬，
10 個空瓶子，
30 瓶綠色藥水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah, hello.
Please give me a minute,
I've just received a message.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊，你好。
請給我一分鐘，
我剛收到一條
訊息。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah!
It says here
that my delivery
has finally arrived!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊！
上面說我的
包裹終於
送到了！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Would you bring me the
box from the firecracker
lady at the entrance
to Luoyang? Thanks
in advance.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你能幫我去
洛陽入口處的
爆竹小姐那裡
拿個箱子嗎？
先謝過了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah. Thank you,
I needed this. Now,
shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊，謝謝，
我正需要這個。
那麼，我們
開始吧？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
First, I shall mix a poison extracted from Venom Canine
with a foreign liquid named Karvodailnirol.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
首先，我將把
從毒犬身上提取的
毒液，與一種名為
卡勒波迪藥水的外來液體混合。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Then, I add Green Herb extract, poison extracted from Bee Sting and a Large Jellopy into the liquid! Finally, I must heat them all!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
然後，我加入
綠色藥草提取物、
從蜜蜂身上提取的
毒液以及巨大傑勒比結晶！
最後，我必須加熱它們！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Finally, I have to carefully heat the mixture and collect it all into a Potion Bottle.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
最後，我必須
小心地加熱混合物，
並將其收集到
藥水瓶中。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Now, I've got to do this just right. This is a very delicate procedure...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
現在，我必須一次成功。這是一個非常精細的過程...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
No!! I failed again! ^666666*Sigh...*^000000 And I spent a long time preparing all of those materials...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
不！！我又失敗了！^666666*嘆氣*^000000 我花了很長時間準備這些材料...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah, hello.
Please give me a minute,
I've just received a message.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊，你好。
請給我一分鐘，
我剛收到一條
訊息。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah!
It says here
that my delivery
has finally arrived!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊！
上面說我的
包裹終於
送到了！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Would you bring me the
box from the firecracker
lady at the entrance
to Luoyang? Thanks
in advance.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你能幫我去
洛陽入口處的
爆竹小姐那裡
拿個箱子嗎？
先謝過了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Oh! You brought
me everything I need!
I'm very impressed!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哦！你把我需要的東西都帶來了！
真讓我刮目相看！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
You're the only one
who actually understands how
I feel. Thank you for gathering all of these ^FF0000materials^000000.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你是唯一真正理解我感受的人。
謝謝你收集了所有這些^FF0000材料^000000。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Alright, now
to create the poison.
This is going to be tough.
Here we go...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
好了，現在開始製作毒藥。
這會很難。
開始吧...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
First, I shall mix a poison extracted from Venom Canine
with a foreign liquid named Karvodailnirol.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
首先，我將把
從毒犬身上提取的
毒液，與一種名為
卡勒波迪藥水的外來液體混合。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Then, I add Green Herb extract,
a poison extracted from Bee Sting and a Large Jellopy!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
然後，我加入綠色藥草提取物、
從史汀身上提取的毒液
以及巨大傑勒比結晶！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Finally, I have to carefully heat the mixture and collect it all into a Potion Bottle.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
最後，我必須
小心地加熱混合物，
並將其收集到
藥水瓶中。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
*Phew...*
Did...
Did I make it?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
*呼...*
成...成功了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hahaha~!
Success! 
It works!
I finally created it!
Mwahahahahahah!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哈哈~！
成功了！
有效！
我終於做出來了！
哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Muhahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
嗚哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Muhahahahaha!
Hahahahahahahahahahah!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
嗚哈哈哈！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I made it!
I made it!
Now, revenge will be mine!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
做出來了！
做出來了！
現在，復仇將屬於我！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hahaha! Now, please
take this bottle. But be careful. Even if you smell it just a little, it can cause your body to decompose, leading to death.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哈哈！請收下這個瓶子。
但請小心。即使只是聞到一點，
也會導致身體分解，進而死亡。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
First, I shall mix a poison extracted from Venom Canine
with a foreign liquid named Karvodailnirol.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
首先，我將把
從毒犬身上提取的
毒液，與一種名為
卡勒波迪藥水的外來液體混合。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Then I add Green Herb extract, a poison extracted from Bee Sting and a Large Jellopy!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
然後，我加入綠色藥草提取物、
從史汀身上提取的毒液
以及巨大傑勒比結晶！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Then I must carefully heat the mixture, and gather it all into a potion bottle.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
然後，我必須小心地加熱混合物，
並將其收集到空藥瓶中。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
*Phew...*
Did...
Did I make it?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
*呼...*
成...成功了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
NO! I... I've failed again! And I spent a long time getting everything ready...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
不！我...我又失敗了！
我花了很長時間準備所有材料...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I'm not sure what went wrong.
Hmm, would you please help me again? I've used all the materials from last time.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我不確定哪裡出了問題。
嗯，你能再幫我一次嗎？
上次的材料都用完了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
^0000FF4 Bee Sting^000000,
^0000FF10 Venom Canine^000000,
^0000FF10 Empty Potion Bottle^000000,
^0000FF30 Green Potion^000000 and
^0000FF1 Large Jellopy^000000.

[Song Zhi Du]
That's everything I'll need.
I would apologize, but since you've shown that you'll help carry out my revenge, I know you'll understand.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
這就是我需要的所有東西。
我想道歉，但既然你願意幫助我實施復仇，
我知道你會理解的。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hahahaha...!
Now, time has come.
With this poison, Luoyang's
lord will be cast into hell!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哈哈哈...！
現在，時刻到了。
用這毒藥，
洛陽的主人將被打入地獄！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
If they lied about my master,
then I'll simply make their lies into truth. Then, my master
won't feel victimized!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
如果他們對我的師父撒謊，
那我就讓他們的謊言變成事實。
這樣，我的師父就不會感到委屈了！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Lord Bai Long!
You will die!
Ha HA HA HA HA!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
白龍大人！
你死定了！
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Muhahahaha!
Hahaha...Haha..hahaha..haha...hahahahaha...mmmmuhahahahahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
哈哈哈...哈哈...哈哈...哈哈...哈哈哈哈哈...穆哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Muhahahahahaha!
...........
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah, forgive me.
I was overly excited.
Yes, I must calm down...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊，請原諒我。
我剛才太激動了。
是的，我必須冷靜下來...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Now, I have one last favor to ask of you. Please sneak into the Castle of the Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
現在，我還有一個最後的請求。請潛入龍宮。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I want you to put this poison some place where Lord Bai Long might stay. But be careful, the castle has a lot of security.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我要你把這毒藥放在白龍大人可能會待的地方。但小心點，龍宮的安保很嚴密。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Still, you're an adventurer from Midgard. You've probably had challenges like this before, so I'm sure you'll find a way.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
不過，你是來自米德加爾特的冒險者。你肯定經歷過類似的挑戰，我相信你能找到辦法。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Anyway, I'm sure my master
will be happy to know that
I finally created the ^0000FFpoison
he wished to create^000000!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
總之，我相信我的師父
一定會很高興知道
我終於製造出了
他想要的^0000FF毒藥^000000！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hahaha...!
Master, I did it!
Your disciple Song Zhi Du made the world's deadliest poison for you!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哈哈哈...！
師父，我做到了！
您的弟子宋志度為您製造出了
世界上最致命的毒藥！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Remember...
The Castle of the Dragon
is under heavy surveillance.
I guess Lord Bai Long is
insecure. Heh heh.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
記住...
龍宮處於嚴密的監視之下。
看來白龍大人很沒有安全感。嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Anyways, I hope you'll be
really careful. When you go in, don't forget to use this poison somewhere the Lord Bai Long
can ingest it.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
總之，希望你一定要小心。
進去後，別忘了把毒藥
放在白龍大人能攝入的地方。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Anyway, I'm sure my master
will be happy to know that
I finally created the ^0000FFpoison
he wished to create^000000!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
總之，我相信我的師父
一定會很高興知道
我終於製造出了
他想要的^0000FF毒藥^000000！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hahaha...!
Master, I did it!
Your disciple Song Zhi Du made the world's deadliest poison for you!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哈哈哈...！
師父，我做到了！
您的弟子宋志度為您製造出了
世界上最致命的毒藥！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Leave now,
my friend!
For my revenge!
Go and kill Lord Bai Long!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
現在去吧，
我的朋友！
為了我的復仇！
去殺了白龍大人！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah!
You came back!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊！
你回來了！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah yes.
All I have to do now
is wait and hear news
of Lord Bai Long's death.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊，是的。
我現在只需要等待
白龍大人死亡的訊息了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Thank you so much, my friend. You've satisfied my old grudge.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
非常感謝你，我的朋友。你幫我解開了多年的心結。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Now, I am getting tired.
Let me rest... Take care, my friend, and travel in safety.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
現在，我有些累了。
讓我休息一下吧...保重，我的朋友，一路順風。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
But before you go, let me give you some poison and a medicinal pill.
I made these with the leftover materials and medicine in the storage.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
但在你走之前，讓我給你一些毒藥和藥丸。
我是用倉庫裡剩下的材料和藥材製作的。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Please take the
medicine pill
right away.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
請立刻
服用
這顆藥丸。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou swallowed a strange pill
that shines with a gold color.
It tastes bitter...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你吞下了一顆閃爍著金色光芒的奇怪藥丸。
味道很苦...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe nasty taste lingers in your mouth, but then you feel a great warmth flowing throughout your body. Eventually, you pass out.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF難吃的味道在口中 lingering，但隨後你感到一股巨大的暖流流遍全身。最終，你昏了過去。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFSong Zhi Du looks blankly at the ceiling. With his revenge, it seems he's lost his motivation in life. Was it a good idea to help him, after all?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF宋志度呆呆地望著天花板。似乎因為復仇，他失去了生活的動力。當初幫他，真的是個正確的決定嗎？^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFBy hearsay, the poisoned drink didn't work so well, as a Thief from a foreign land actually stole the bottle.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF據傳聞，那杯毒酒並沒有奏效，因為一位來自異國的盜賊偷走了那瓶酒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
What happened?
Why isn't
Lord Bai Long dead yet?!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
怎麼回事？
為什麼白龍大人
還沒死？！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hmmm...
You don't have
a different plot
in mind, do you?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
嗯...
你該不會
另有圖謀吧？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah...
Welcome.
My master told
me everything.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊...
歡迎。
師父把
一切都告訴我了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Somehow, I feel relieved, but sorry at the same time. Still, now I can forget everything that's happened in the past.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
不知為何，我感到既如釋重負又有些抱歉。不過，現在我可以忘掉過去發生的一切了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Now, I've decided to focus more on my medical studies so that I can really save as many lives as I can. I'm sorry I've been so rude to you before.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
現在，我決定更加專注於醫學研究，以便真正拯救更多的生命。抱歉我之前對你那麼無禮。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Also, I hope you will
take these, since I don't
need them any longer.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
另外，既然我不再需要這些了，
希望你能收下。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Thank you
once again, friend.
Now, if you'll excuse me,
I have many things to do...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
再次
謝謝你，朋友。
那麼，失陪了，
我還有很多事要做...

scripts.text: ^3355FFSong Zhi Du is busily engaged with organizing medicinal herbs. The faint look of sadness that used to be on his face now seems drained.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF宋志度正忙著整理草藥。他臉上曾經那淡淡的憂傷似乎已經消散了。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFStill, from his movements and the pace at which he is working, you can tell that he loves what he is doing. It seems that Song Zhi Du has finally found his life's path.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF不過，從他的動作和工作的節奏來看，可以看出他熱愛自己的工作。看來宋志度終於找到了自己的人生道路。^000000

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Nagash Arses is also the name of poison king in a legend of Arcturus. There's good reason for my master to be proud of his name!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
納加什·阿爾塞斯也是阿爾克圖斯傳說中“毒王”的名字。師父對自己的名字感到自豪是有充分理由的！

scripts.text:
^3355FF * Wait a minute! *
Currently, you're carrying too many items. Please put some of your things into Kafra Storage and try again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF * 等等！ *
你攜帶的物品太多了。請將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後重試。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady]
You're at the
entrance of Luoyang.
I hope you enjoy
your stay here~
scripts.translation:
[女士]
你正站在洛陽的入口處。
祝你在這裡玩得開心~

scripts.text:
[Lady]
You're at the entrance of Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
你正站在洛陽的入口處。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Luoyang is well known
for its various firecrackers.
Would you like to see one?
scripts.translation:
[女士]
洛陽以各種煙花聞名。
你想看一個嗎？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: No thanks~
scripts.translation: 不用了~

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Alright, there you go!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
好了，給你！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Hmpf...!

[Lady]
Would you
like to see some
firecrackers?
scripts.translation:
[女士]
你想看
煙花嗎？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: No thanks~
scripts.translation: 不用了~

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Alright,
there you go!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
好了，給你！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Hmm, if not firecrackers,
then you must want something
else. Did someone send you?
scripts.translation:
[女士]
嗯，如果不是煙花，
那你一定是想要別的東西。
是有人派你來的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Who was it?
Please tell me
his name.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
是誰？
請告訴我
他的名字。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Oh, I see.
Let me give
you the package.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
哦，我明白了。
讓我把包裹
給你。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Ah, wait! I forgot!
You must first pay the
delivery fee of 1,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
啊，等等！我忘了！
你必須先支付
1,000 Zeny的運費。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Thank you~
Now that the fee is paid,
please bring this to
Song Zhi Du.
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
謝謝~
既然運費已經付了，
請把這個交給
宋志度。
再見！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Errr...
You don't have enough zeny for the fee. I can't give you the package unless the delivery fee is paid!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
呃...
你的Zeny不夠支付運費。除非支付運費，否則我不能給你包裹！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Hmmm?
I don't know who that is.
So I definitely don't have
a package for whoever you're
talking about.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
嗯？
我不認識那個人。
所以我肯定沒有
給那個人的包裹。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
No...?

[Lady]
Are you...
Coming on to me?
scripts.translation:
[女士]
你是在...
向我搭訕嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lady]
You're at the
entrance of Luoyang.
I hope you have a good time~
scripts.translation:
[女士]
你在洛陽的入口。
祝你玩得開心~

entrance of

scripts.translation:

你在洛陽的入口。

scripts.translation:

你想看一個嗎？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: No thanks~
scripts.translation: 不用了~

Alright~

scripts.translation:

好了~

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Hmpf...!

[Soldier]
Who goes there!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
什麼人！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou ran away as quickly as you could!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你儘可能快地逃跑了！^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Huh...?
What was
that noise?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嗯...？
剛才那是什麼
聲音？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou bolted away from the castle as fast as your legs could carry you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你以最快的速度逃離了城堡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Huh...?
Is somebody there?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嗯...？
那裡有人嗎？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou escaped from the soldier's suspicious gaze.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你逃出了士兵懷疑的目光。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hold it right there, Midgardian!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
站住，米德加德人！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou run as fast as you can before the soldiers can catch you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在士兵追上你之前拼命奔跑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Huh...?
I hear something!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嗯...？
我聽到什麼聲音了！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou escape before the soldier can find you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在士兵發現你之前逃走了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's this?
A crack in the wall?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是什麼？
牆上的裂縫？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou jump to the stone wall and peep into the crack. It looks big enough for someone to squeeze through.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你跳到石牆上，從裂縫裡往裡看。看起來足夠一個人擠過去。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou move through the crack as quickly as you can.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你儘可能快地穿過裂縫。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou found a drink bottle that's possibly owned by Bai Long, lord of Luoyang.^00000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個酒瓶，可能是洛陽之主白龍的所有物。^00000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou put the deadly poison into the bottle.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把致命猛毒倒進了瓶子裡。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt would be smart to get out of this place as soon as you can.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF儘快離開這個地方比較明智。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou take the drink bottle and replace it with a bottle filled with Sticky Mucus. Hopefully Bai Long won't notice!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿走了酒瓶，並用裝滿粘稠液體的瓶子替換了它。希望白龍大人不會發現！^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt seems that you need switch Bai Long's drinking bottle with something else. Just taking the drink bottle would arouse suspicion.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看來你需要用別的東西替換白龍大人的酒瓶。只拿走酒瓶會引人懷疑。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFMaybe if you found some kind of empty bottle and filled it with something, like Sticky Mucus...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF也許你可以找一個空瓶，裡面裝些東西，比如粘稠液體...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou found a drink bottle. It's fancy enough that the only possible owner could be Bai Long, lord of Luoyang.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個酒瓶。它很精緻，唯一可能的擁有者就是洛陽的白龍大人。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou squeeze through the crack as quickly as you can.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你儘可能快地擠過裂縫。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou squeeze through the crack as quickly as you can.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你儘可能快地擠過裂縫。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF * Wait a minute! *
Right now you're carrying too many items. Please put some of your things into Kafra Storage and try again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF * 等等！ *
你攜帶的物品太多了。請將一些物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再試一次。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Hey...!
You're not doing
anything suspicious
are you?
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
嘿...！
你沒有什麼
可疑的行為
吧？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou run away
from Bai Long as
fast as you can!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你以最快的速度
逃離了白龍大人！^000000

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Hahahaha!
Welcome to Luoyang!
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
哈哈哈！
歡迎來到洛陽！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Luoyang is such a great city.
We've protected this land for forty years from the invasions of evil creatures!
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
洛陽是一座偉大的城市。
我們保護這片土地四十年，抵禦邪惡生物的入侵！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
I hope you enjoy
your stay here,
Midgardian!
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
希望你在
這裡住得
愉快，米德加德人！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou give Nagash Arses' Journal
to Bai Long. He reads it intently, slowly turning each page.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你將納加什·阿爾塞斯的日記交給了白龍大人。他專注地閱讀著，緩慢地翻動著每一頁。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHe's completely silent for about fifteen minutes, and focuses all
of his attention of the journal.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF他沉默了大約十五分鐘，全神貫注地注視著這本日記。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA single tear trickles
from his eye as he reads
the words of Nagash Arse...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF當他讀到納加什·阿爾塞斯寫下的文字時，一滴淚水從他的眼角滑落...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Thank you..
Adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
謝謝你...
冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Thank you so much.
You've helped me make
up with an old friend!
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
非常感謝你。
你幫我與一位老朋友冰釋前嫌！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
I, Bai Long, will work on giving
fair treatment to all of martial arts organizations, regardless of their methods or philosophies!
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
我，白龍，將致力於公平對待所有武術組織，無論他們的方法或理念如何！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
I will also forgive Song Zhi Du, even if he tried to poison me.
He is innocent...
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
我也會原諒宋志度，即使他曾試圖毒害我。
他是無辜的...

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
As a matter of fact, it was reported to me that Nagash was deported to his homeland after
that incident. I had no idea
he was in jail!
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
事實上，有人向我報告說，在那次事件之後，納加什被遣返回了他的祖國。我完全不知道他是在坐牢！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Thank you so
much for your help!
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
非常感謝你的幫助！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Please, take this as a token of gratitute. And please deliver this letter to Nagash and Song Zhi Du for me.
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
請收下這個作為謝禮。另外，請幫我把這封信交給納加什和宋志度。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou obtained ^0000FFBai Long's letter^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你獲得了 ^0000FF白龍大人的信^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Thank you in advance.
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
先謝過你了。

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
How could I have lost my friend from our glory days? Hmm...?
Oh, I didn't realize you were still there... Listening to me.
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
我怎麼會失去那位與我共赴輝煌歲月的朋友呢？嗯...？
哦，我都沒注意到你還在那裡...聽我自言自語。

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
I'm sorry, I was just talking to myself. I hope you have a good time while staying here in Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[白龍大人]
抱歉，我剛才只是在自言自語。希望你在洛陽期間過得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hey...
There's something
fishy about you...!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嘿...
你看起來有點...
可疑...！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou escaped from the castle, far away from the suspicious guard...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你逃離了城堡，遠離了那位可疑的衛兵...^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
^666666*Yawn*^000000 It's so boring here nowadays. Although, I hear that
a long time ago, things were
much different.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
^666666*哈欠*^000000 最近這裡真無聊。不過，我聽說很久以前，這裡的情況大不相同。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Supposedly, monsters used to intrude Luoyang all the time! Heh, but that's just a rumor. Still, there are a bunch of rumors going around that I'm curious about...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
據說，魔物以前經常入侵洛陽！呵，那只是謠言。不過，最近流傳著一些讓我好奇的傳聞...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Huh...?
Is somebody there?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
咦...？
那裡有人嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou ran away
as quickly
as you could.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你以最快的速度
逃跑了。^000000

scripts.text: Hey, wake up!
scripts.translation: 嘿，醒醒！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Yeeeesss...Sir!
I was not dozing off~ seerious...ly...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
是...是的，長官！
我並沒有打瞌睡...真的...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
...

[Soldier]
Huh...?
What was that?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
咦...？
剛才是什麼聲音？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou escape the soldier's
suspicious gaze as quickly
as you can.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你迅速逃離了士兵懷疑的目光。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
People have been
saying that there's
a scammer at the
entrance of town...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
有人聽說，
在城鎮入口處
有個騙子...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
But I went there and I didn't
find anyone suspicious. I swear, everything seemed completely normal!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
但我去了那裡，並沒有發現任何可疑的人。我發誓，一切看起來都很正常！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Who goes there?!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
什麼人？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou ran away
as quickly
as you could.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你以最快的速度
逃跑了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Ah, don't bother
to listen to this
guy beside of me.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
啊，別聽我旁邊
這傢伙瞎說。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I hope you have a good time while you're staying here in Luoyang!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
希望您在我們洛陽停留期間玩得愉快！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Where there's a will,
there's a way. When we
work together, there's
nothing we cannot do.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
有志者事竟成。
當我們齊心協力時，
沒有什麼事是做不到的。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Will you lend us your power, and help us build a better future? Will you join our movement for social reform in Luoyang?
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
你願意借給我們你的力量，幫助我們建設更美好的未來嗎？你願意加入我們在洛陽的社會改革運動嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
It doesn't matter if you're a local or a foreigner. So long as we share the same goal of creating a better Luoyang, where everyone is treated as an equal.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
無論你是當地人還是外地人，只要我們都懷著同一個目標，那就是創造一個更好的洛陽，在那裡每個人都被平等對待。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
My name...
is Sun Mao.
This invitation may be sudden, but I am a man of action. I see in your face that you too despise injustice.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
我的名字...
是孫茂。
這份邀請可能有些突然，但我是一個行動派。我從你的臉上看出，你也憎惡邪惡使者。

scripts.text: What am I supposed to do?
scripts.translation: 我該怎麼做？

scripts.text: I will join you!
scripts.translation: 我加入你們！

scripts.text: Well, I'm just another tourist...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我只是個遊客...

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
For now, we must recruit as many members as we can. When we're ready, we'll start a movement that will change Luoyang, and even the world!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
目前，我們必須招募儘可能多的成員。當我們準備就緒時，我們將發起一場改變洛陽，甚至改變世界的運動！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
However, we currently do not have the manpower to carry out the plans we have laid out. We've been lucky the lord hasn't found us out yet.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
然而，我們目前人手不足，無法執行既定計劃。幸運的是，領主還沒有發現我們。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I wish everyone would understand our intentions, but the people of this city are disunited. This is not the first time I have approached a foreigner for help...
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
我希望所有人都能理解我們的意圖，但這座城市的人們並不團結。這並非我第一次向外來者尋求幫助...

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I suppose you understand the urgency of our cause, and our need to gather others who see the merit of our goals!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
我想你應該理解我們事業的緊迫性，以及我們需要召集更多認同我們目標的人！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Oh, God must be on my side today and has sent you to me. Thank you for making the big decision...
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
噢，看來神明今天站在我這邊，派你來到了我面前。謝謝你做出了這個重大決定...

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I shall then engrave your name
on this bloody pledge board. But before I do so, I shall ask once more. Do you truly wish to join us, through pain and bloodshed?
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
那麼，我將把你的名字刻在這塊血誓板上。但在這麼做之前，我要再問一次。你真的願意加入我們，哪怕要經歷痛苦和流血嗎？

scripts.text: No, wait!
scripts.translation: 不，等等！

scripts.text: I am 100% sure.
scripts.translation: 我百分之百確定。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I understand if you need time to decide. If you do decide to join us, please return. Time is on our side, after all.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
如果你需要時間考慮，我理解。如果你決定加入我們，請回來。畢竟，時間站在我們這邊。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
{0}...!
Your name is now engraved on this bloody pledge board. We will fight together to the death for Luoyang's future!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
{0}...！
你的名字現在已刻在這塊血誓板上。我們將為洛陽的未來並肩戰鬥至死！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Now, the most important thing for our cause is to gather more recruits and increase our numbers. Please find others who will join us in our fight.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
現在，對我們事業最重要的是招募更多成員，壯大我們的隊伍。請去尋找其他願意加入戰鬥的人。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
However, as to not arouse suspicion, bring only one new recruit at a time. Also, we suggest not to bring a friend in a party with you.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
不過，為了不引起懷疑，每次只帶一名新成員。另外，我們建議不要帶朋友組隊同行。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Now, I will wait for you here. Go forth and find others who wish for a better future for Luoyang!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
現在，我會在這裡等你。去吧，去尋找那些希望洛陽擁有更美好未來的人！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please assist the people who fight behind you. As more are gathered, one of our comrades will inform you of further instructions.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
請協助那些在你身後戰鬥的人。隨著人數增加，我們的同志會向你傳達進一步的指示。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Are you...? I see, you may leave now. Do not reveal what you have seen or heard in this place.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
你是...？我明白了，你可以離開了。不要洩露你在這裡看到或聽到的任何事。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
If you're a real tourist, you do not want to get involved in our business, one way or another.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
如果你真的是個遊客，就不想以任何方式捲入我們的事務。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Once again,
thank you for
your trouble.
Go back safe.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
再次感謝你的配合。
請安全回去。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Oh, you brought a new comrade! Welcome. Please help your friend understand our intentions before joining us.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
噢，你帶來了一位新同志！歡迎。請在加入我們之前，幫助你的朋友理解我們的意圖。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please bring another friend that both of you can trust. Remember, add one person at a time into your party.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
請再帶一位你們兩人都信任的朋友。記住，每次只向隊伍中新增一個人。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
The three of you may all move together for our cause. Please try to find another recruit to be your fourth member, invite him to your party and bring him to this place.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
你們三人可以一起為我們的事業行動。請嘗試再找一名招募物件作為你們的第四名成員，邀請他加入隊伍並帶到這個地方。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Ah, now there are four of you. However, we must continue to strengthen our ranks at a cautious pace. Please go and find one new recruit, and only one, to add to your party.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
啊，現在你們有四個人了。然而，我們必須謹慎地繼續壯大隊伍。請去尋找一名新招募物件，且只能是一名，加入你們的隊伍。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Now, there are five of you. Needless to say, we still require more manpower. Please go out and seek another new member for our cause. Remember, only add one more person to your party and return to me.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
現在你們有五個人了。不用說，我們仍然需要更多的人手。請出去為我們的事業再尋找一名新成員。記住，只向隊伍中新增一個人，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
There are now six of you. So far, so good. Please go forth and find just one more person to add to your party and bring him to me so that we may recruit him.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
現在你們有六個人了。目前進展順利。請再去找一個人加入隊伍，並把他帶到我這裡，以便我們招募他。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Now, there are seven of you, but we still lack the manpower we need. Please go forth and seek out one, and only one, more person to add to your party and then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
現在你們有七個人了，但我們仍然缺乏所需的人手。請再去找一個人，且只能是一個人，加入隊伍，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
[Sun Mao]
Great work, you've brought another new comrade! Welcome! Please explain our goals and the righteousness of our cause to our new friend so that he may fully join us.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
幹得好，你又帶來了一位新同志！歡迎！請向我們的新朋友解釋我們的目標以及我們事業的正義性，以便他能完全加入我們。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Otherwise, other people may learn of what we are doing, and that will lead to trouble.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
否則，其他人可能會得知我們在做什麼，那將會帶來麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Great work, you've brought another new comrade! Welcome! Please explain our goals and the righteousness of our cause to our new friend so that he may fully join us.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
幹得好，你又帶來了一位新同志！歡迎！請向我們的新朋友解釋我們的目標以及我們事業的正義性，以便他能完全加入我們。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
It is almost time to take the action...
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
是時候採取行動了...

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I recognize your pledge to fight for us, but I fear that you are not yet ready for the task I have available for you.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
我認可你們為我們戰鬥的承諾，但我擔心你們還沒有準備好接受我分配的任務。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
However, we still have time. Go out and train with the party members you have gathered to gain more experience.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
不過，我們還有時間。出去和你召集的隊伍成員一起訓練，以獲取更多的經驗。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Together, all of you will be able to train faster than if you were to go train alone. Come back when you feel that you are ready for this task.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
大家一起訓練，會比單獨訓練更快。當你覺得準備好接受這個任務時，再回來。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
At long last, there are eight of you. Now, I believe there is among manpower amongst you to carry out this mission. Please listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
終於，你們有八個人了。現在，我相信你們之中有足夠的人手來執行這項任務。請仔細聽好。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
The martial arts organizations of Luoyang, as you may well know, have been divided between those that fight for justice, and those that serve evil purposes.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
正如你們所知，洛陽的武術組織已經分裂，一部分為正義而戰，另一部分則服務於邪惡的目的。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Recently, some of the evil organizations have conspired with corrupt government officials in the interest to expand their power.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
最近，一些邪惡組織與腐敗的政府官員勾結，以擴大他們的權力。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
These corrupt government officials have been suspicious of our gunpowder research and arrested our comrade, ^3355FFHao Chenryu^000000, our gunpowder expert, under the pretext of investigation.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
這些腐敗的政府官員對我們的火藥研究感到懷疑，並以調查為藉口逮捕了我們的同志，^3355FF郝辰宇^000000，我們的火藥專家。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Without him, we cannot continue the gunpowder research, or produce the gunpowder we'll need for our movement. We must contact him so that he may make gunpowder for us.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
沒有他，我們無法繼續火藥研究，也無法生產我們運動所需的火藥。我們必須聯絡他，讓他為我們製造火藥。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Unfortunately, many of us cannot contact him, as our identities are known to the officials. However, since you are new recruits, as well as Midgardians, they will not know how you are.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
不幸的是，我們中的許多人無法聯絡他，因為我們的身份已被官員知曉。然而，由於你們是新的招募物件，也是米德加爾德人，他們不會知道你們的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Your mission will be to deliver these chemicals to our comrade Hao Chenryu who is held captive by the government.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
你們的任務是將這些化學品送到被政府囚禁的我們的同志郝辰宇手中。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Since flammable chemicals are not allowed inside government offices, you must keep them well hidden. If the chemicals are equally divided among the eight of you, we might succeed!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
由於易燃化學品不允許進入政府辦公室，你們必須將它們藏好。如果這些化學品在你們八個人之間平均分配，我們可能會成功！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
There you go. Now, divide these materials equally among the eight of you. The eight of you must fully cooperate with each other, or our plan will fail. Understood?
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
給你。現在，將這些材料在你們八個人之間平均分配。你們八個人必須完全合作，否則我們的計劃就會失敗。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
You made a party. Now, why don't you go recruit more followers? For now, just add one more person, lest we arouse the suspicion of our enemies.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
你們組建了一支隊伍。現在，為什麼不去招募更多的信徒呢？暫時只再新增一個人，以免引起敵人的懷疑。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Hmmm...
Having trouble finding a third person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
嗯...
在尋找加入隊伍的第三個人時遇到困難了嗎？找到值得信賴的人很重要。小心行事，別被抓住了！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Hmmm...
Having trouble finding a forth person to add to your party? I understand that it's important that you find someone you can trust. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
嗯...
在尋找加入隊伍的第四個人時遇到困難了嗎？我理解找到值得信賴的人很重要。小心行事，別被抓住了！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Having trouble finding a fifth person to add to your party? I understand that it's important that you find someone you can trust. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
在尋找加入隊伍的第五個人時遇到困難了嗎？我理解找到值得信賴的人很重要。小心行事，別被抓住了！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Having trouble finding a six person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
在尋找加入隊伍的第六個人時遇到困難了嗎？找到值得信賴的人很重要。小心行事，別被抓住了！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Having trouble finding a seventh person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
在尋找加入隊伍的第七個人時遇到困難了嗎？找到值得信賴的人很重要。小心行事，別被抓住了！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Hmmm...
Having trouble finding an eighth person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
嗯...
在尋找加入隊伍的第八個人時遇到困難了嗎？找到值得信賴的人很重要。小心行事，別被抓住了！

scripts.text: [Sun Mao]
scripts.translation: [孫茂]

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Oh no! You've brought more than one more person to join us! We can't do any recruiting now, it will bring unnecessary attention to our activities!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
糟糕！你們帶的人比計劃中多了一個！我們現在不能進行招募了，這會引起不必要的注意！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please make sure that there is a total of two members in your party so that we can recruit your friend. I believe that will look natural.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
請確保隊伍中總共有兩名成員，這樣我們才能招募你的朋友。我相信這樣看起來會比較自然。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
At this stage in our plan, we cannot afford any unnecessary attention to our activities! Please make sure that there is a total of three members in your party so that we can recruit your friend.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
在我們計劃的這個階段，我們不能承受任何不必要的注意！請確保隊伍中總共有三名成員，這樣我們才能招募你的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please make sure that there is a total of four members in your party so that we can recruit your friend. I believe that will look natural.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
請確保隊伍中總共有四名成員，這樣我們才能招募你的朋友。我相信這樣看起來會比較自然。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please make sure that there is a total of five members in your party so that we can recruit your friend. I believe that will look natural.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
請確保隊伍中總共有五名成員，這樣我們才能招募你的朋友。我相信這樣看起來會比較自然。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
By this time, you should know that you should only bring one more person at a time. You know that it is crucial that we do not attract any undue attention before we can take action!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
到了這個時候，你應該知道每次只能多帶一個人。你知道在我們採取行動之前，不引起任何不當注意是多麼關鍵！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
At this stage in our plan, we cannot afford any unnecessary attention to our activities! Please make sure that there is a total of eight members in your party so that we can recruit your friend.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
在我們計劃的這個階段，我們不能承受任何不必要的注意！請確保隊伍中總共有八名成員，這樣我們才能招募你的朋友。

scripts.text: [Sun Mao]
scripts.translation: [孫茂]

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Welcome back! I see that the mission has been successfully accomplished! Great work, men!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
歡迎回來！看來任務已經成功完成了！幹得好，夥計們！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Finally, we have a weapon to mete out severe retribution to our enemies, the corrupt government officials and the evil martial arts organizations! I appreciate your help, comrades.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
終於，我們有了武器，可以對腐敗的政府官員和邪惡的武術組織進行嚴厲的報復！感謝你們的幫助，同志們。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please take these funds and share them with your party members. I hope that all of you will lend your power to our cause once again.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
請收下這些資金，並與你的隊伍成員分享。我希望你們所有人都能再次為我們的事業貢獻力量。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Once again, I thank you for your help. Now, go in safety.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
再次感謝你們的幫助。現在，請安全離開。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Your mission is to take the materials I have given you and your party members, and to smuggle them to Hao Chenryu.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
你們的任務是帶著我給你的材料和你隊伍成員的材料，將它們走私給郝辰宇。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Hao Chenryu is currently held captive by corrupt members of the government. Remember to divide the materials equally among your party members so that the officials do find them.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
郝辰宇目前被腐敗的政府成員囚禁。記得將材料在隊伍成員之間平均分配，以免被官員發現。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Huh, where are all your members? Come back to me with all of your recruits.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
嗯，你的成員們呢？
帶著你所有的招募人員回來見我。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Remember that you move together with your comrades. There isn't a traitor amongst you, is there?
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
記住，你要與你的同志們一起行動。
你們中間沒有叛徒吧？

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Ah...
You have
returned!
Ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
啊...
你回來了！
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I would like to commend you and your comrades for your excellent performance in the last mission. Come back anytime if you wish to be assigned to another task for our cause.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
我要表揚你和你的同志們在上一項任務中的出色表現。
如果你們想為我們的事業接受新的任務，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Remember that the authoritative center of the party is its leader. The party members must act as one in order to accomplish their goals.
scripts.translation:
[孫茂]
記住，隊伍的核心權威是首領。
隊伍成員必須團結一致，才能達成目標。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Who...
Are you?
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
你...
是誰？

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
I only trust my comrades in the cause for Luoyang, so leave me alone. Death before oppression! Freedom for Luoyang!
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
我只信任為洛陽事業奮鬥的同志們，所以請別打擾我。
寧死不屈！洛陽自由！

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Mao told me that eight Midgardians
would be coming.
But what happened?
I'm confused...
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
茂告訴我會有八個米德加德人過來。
但發生了什麼？
我很困惑...

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Mao's plans are flawless,
so I'm sticking to the scenario he's drawn up. You're either improvising needlessly, or you're not really my comrade...
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
茂的計劃是無懈可擊的，
所以我堅持按照他制定的方案行事。你要麼是在不必要的即興發揮，要麼你根本不是我的同志...

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Ah, I see that Mao
has sent you. I'm sorry
for the trouble you've
gone through to smuggle
the chemicals to me, comrade.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
啊，我明白了，
是茂派你來的。很抱歉，
讓你費心為我走私這些化學品，同志。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Please give me
a minute so that
I may quickly make
the gunpowder.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
請給我一分鐘，
讓我快速製作
火藥。

scripts.text: Make Gunpowder.
scripts.translation: 製作火藥

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
I don't want you to be caught if the soldiers inspect your goods. It will be better if one of you carry a Cart and hide the gunpowder in there.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
如果士兵檢查你們的貨物，我不想讓你被抓。
最好由你們其中一人租用手推車，把火藥藏在裡面。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Is...
Something wrong?!
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
怎...
怎麼了？！

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
I guess we must
be extra careful,
as there is much
surveillance in
this place.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
看來我們必須格外小心，
因為這裡有很多
監視。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Hmmm...
It seems like
you're one of us.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
嗯...
看來你是我們
自己人。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
If you came for the
gunpowder, you should
get some chemcials
from your party leader.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
如果你是來取火藥的，
你應該從你的隊伍首領那裡
拿一些化學品。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Be careful!
It's easy for
gunpowder to be
found during the
inspection process!
Hide it well...!
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
小心！
火藥很容易在
檢查過程中被發現！
藏好它...

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
I hope you bring the gunpowder to Mao safely. The next time you see him, please give him my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
希望你能安全地把火藥帶給茂。下次見到他時，請轉達我的謝意。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hold on there!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
站住！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You're not allowed to bring any gunpowder out of here. Now go
and put it back, Midgardian! Move!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你不準把火藥帶出去。現在，把它放回去，米德加德人！快走！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
It's strange to see outsiders in this kind of place. We don't have any business with you,
so move along.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
在這種地方看到外人真是奇怪。我們和你沒有生意往來，請離開。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I am sorry, but it is prohibited to enter with some of the products
you are carrying. I cannot let you in.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
很抱歉，你攜帶的部分物品禁止帶入。我不能讓你進去。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
There is nothing much, but if you wish to look around this room, please be my guest.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
這裡沒什麼特別的，但如果你想四處看看，請便。
